water.name: Water
water.description_en: Good old water, aka H2O. The most common skincare ingredient of all. You can usually find it right in the very first spot of the ingredient list, meaning it’s the biggest thing out of all the stuff that makes up the product.

aqua.name: Water
aqua.description_en: Good old water, aka H2O. The most common skincare ingredient of all. You can usually find it right in the very first spot of the ingredient list, meaning it’s the biggest thing out of all the stuff that makes up the product.

butylene-glycol.name: Butylene Glycol
butylene-glycol.description_en: Butylene glycol, or let’s just call it BG, is a multi-tasking colorless, syrupy liquid. It’s a great pick for creating a nice feeling product.

propylene-glycol.name: Propylene Glycol
propylene-glycol.description_en: Propylene Glycol (PG) is a colorless liquid, whose main job, usually, is toimprovethe so-calledfreeze-thaw stabilityof the products. This means that it makes sure that a product doesn’t freeze or melt in low or high temperatures. To achieve this, small amounts - usually less than 2% - is used.

propanediol.name: Propanediol
propanediol.description_en: Propanediol is anaturalalternative for the often used and often bad-mouthedpropylene glycol. It's produced sustainably from corn sugar and it's Ecocert approved.

pentylene-glycol.name: Pentylene Glycol
pentylene-glycol.description_en: Amulti-functional, silky feeling helperingredient that can do quite many things. It's used as anemulsion stabilizer,solventand a broad spectrumantimicrobial.According to manufacturerinfo, it's also amoisturizerand helps to make the product feel great on the skin. It works synergistically with preservatives and helps to improve water-resistance of sunscreens.

dipropylene-glycol.name: Dipropylene Glycol
dipropylene-glycol.description_en: A clear, colorless liquid that works as a solvent and viscosity decreasing ingredient. It also has great skin-moisturizing abilities.

hexylene-glycol.name: Hexylene Glycol
hexylene-glycol.description_en: Similar toother glycols, it's a helper ingredient used as asolvent, or tothin out thick formulasand make them more nicely spreadable.

ethoxydiglycol.name: Ethoxydiglycol
ethoxydiglycol.description_en: A nice odorless liquid used mainly as asuperior solubilizer and efficacy booster for cosmetic active ingredientssuch as skincare bigshotvitamin C, self-tanning activeDHAor the anti-acne gold standard,benzoyl peroxide.

glycerin.name: Glycerin
glycerin.description_en: Glycerin doesn’t sound very glamorous but it is a realoldie but a goodie. It’s been used in cosmetics for more than  50 years and it’s a totally natural ingredient that’s also in the outermost layer of our skin (called stratum corneum - SC).

glycerol.name: Glycerin
glycerol.description_en: Glycerin doesn’t sound very glamorous but it is a realoldie but a goodie. It’s been used in cosmetics for more than  50 years and it’s a totally natural ingredient that’s also in the outermost layer of our skin (called stratum corneum - SC).

sodium-hyaluronate.name: Sodium Hyaluronate
sodium-hyaluronate.description_en: It’s the - sodium form - cousin of the famousNMF,hyaluronic acid(HA). If HA does not tell you anything we have a super detailed, geeky explanationabout it here.  The TL; DR version of HA is that it's a huge polymer (big molecule from repeated subunits) found in the skin that acts as aspongehelping the skin to hold onto water, being plump and elastic. HA is famous for itscrazy water holding capacityas it can bind up to 1000 times its own weight in water.

hyaluronic-acid.name: Hyaluronic Acid
hyaluronic-acid.description_en: Hyaluronic acid (HA) and its various forms are thecurrent IT-moisturizers. So let’s see, what is hyaluronic acid and even more importantly what’s the big deal about it?

sodium-hyaluronate-crosspolymer.name: Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer
sodium-hyaluronate-crosspolymer.description_en: It's a special"cross-linked" from of IT-moisturizer,hyaluronic acid(HA). Cross-linked means that "normal" HA pieces (1-2 million Da molecular weight) are chemically bound togeather to create a big, "infinite" mesh.

panthenol.name: Panthenol
panthenol.description_en: An easy-to-formulate, commonly used, nice to have ingredient that’s also called pro-vitamin B5. As you might guess from the “pro” part, it’s a precursor to vitamin B5 (whose fancy name is pantothenic acid).

betaine.name: Betaine
betaine.description_en: A sugar beet-derived amino acid derivative withnice skin protection and moisturization properties. Betaine's special thing is being anosmolyte, a molecule that helps tocontrol cell-water balance.  It is also a natural osmoprotectant, meaning that it attracts water away from the protein surface and thus protects them from denaturation and increases their thermodynamic stability.

sodium-pca.name: Sodium PCA
sodium-pca.description_en: PCA stands for Pyrrolidone Carboxylic Acid and though it might not sound like it, it is a thing that can be found naturally in our skin. The sodium salt form of PCA is an importantskin-identical ingredient and great natural moisturizerthat helps the skin to hold onto water and stay nicely hydrated.

sorbitol.name: Sorbitol
sorbitol.description_en: It's a sweet tastingsugar substitutethathelps your skin to hold onto waterwhen used in cosmetic products. It also helps to thicken up products and give them a bit more slip.

sodium-lactate.name: Sodium Lactate
sodium-lactate.description_en: The sodium salt oflactic acid. It's a greatskin moisturizerand also used toregulate the pH valueof the cosmetic formula. It's a natural ingredient approved by both ECOCERT and COSMOS.

urea.name: Urea
urea.description_en: Yes, it's the thing that can be found naturally in pee. And in the skin. It is an awesomenatural moisturizing factor, aka NMF.NMFs are important components that help the skin to hold onto water and keep it plump, elastic and hydrated. Urea makes up about 7% of NMFs next to other things such as amino acids (40%), PCA (12%) or Lactate (12%).

mannitol.name: Mannitol
mannitol.description_en: A type ofsugar molecule, that has water-binding properties and helps tokeep your skin hydrated.

xylitol.name: Xylitol
xylitol.description_en: A type ofsugarthat's part of amoisturizingtrio called Aquaxyl. You can read more about its magic properties atxylitylglucoside.

trehalose.name: Trehalose
trehalose.description_en: A type of sugar that haswater-bindingproperties and helps to keep your skinhydrated.

sucrose.name: Sucrose
sucrose.description_en: A type fosugar, usually refined from cane or beet sugar. On the skin, it haswater-bindingproperties and helps to keep your skinhydrated.

fructose.name: Fructose
fructose.description_en: Fancy name forfruit sugar. It has nicewater-bindingproperties and helps to keep skinhydrated.

glucose.name: Glucose
glucose.description_en: A fancy name forsugar. Luckily when you put it on your skin it's good for you not like when you eat it. :) It haswater-bindingproperties, which means that it helps to keep your skin nice andhydrated.

niacinamide.name: Niacinamide
niacinamide.description_en: Niacinamide, or as us normal people call itvitamin B3,is a real skincare superstar that has had so many studies and has so many skin benefits that we have to warn you that this "geeky details" description will not be short.

retinol.name: Retinol
retinol.description_en: If you like to read about skincare (and if you are here, it seems that you do :)), we are sure that you have already read a lot about retinol. It is the ingredient everyone keeps talking about and there is a reason for that: it is themostproven anti-aging superstaravailable over the counter.

retinyl-palmitate.name: Retinyl Palmitate
retinyl-palmitate.description_en: It's anester form of vitamin A(retinol + palmitic acid) thatbelongs to the "retinoid family". The retinoid family is pretty much the royal family of skincare, with the king being the FDA-approved anti-aging ingredienttretinoin.Retinolis also a very famous member of the family, but it's likePrince George, two steps away from the throne. Retinyl palmitate will be thenPrince Charlotte(George's little sister), quite far (3 steps) away from the throne.

retinal.name: Retinal
retinal.description_en: If you are reading here, we are pretty sure the words retinoids and retinol ring a bell, but if not, you are seriously missing out, pleaseclick here immediately to catch up.  The TL;DR version is thatretinoids are the royal family of skincare with tretinoin being the king, the only FDA-approved ingredient to treat the signs of photoaging.Retinolis like a grandkid, it has to be converted (through two steps) in the skin to become retinoic acid. The conversion means retinol is both less effective and less harsh on the skin.

bakuchiol.name: Bakuchiol
bakuchiol.description_en: At first glance, you could think that Bakuchiol is your averageplant extract. It is derived from the seeds ofPsoralea Corylifolia, aka Babchi, a plant important inIndian and Chinese medicine. The molecule was first isolated in 1973 and several anti-something properties are known about it: it hasanti-inflammatory, antioxidant, anti-tumor, anti-bacterialand hepatoprotective magical abilities like plenty of other Ayurvedic plant extracts.

salicylic-acid.name: Salicylic Acid
salicylic-acid.description_en: If you have ever struggled with let’s just call it “problem skin” (you know, acne, blackheads, whiteheads, large pores) then most probably you are familiar with salicylic acid (SA). Even if the name does not ring a bell, you have probably used it. Next to benzoyl peroxide, it’s thegold standard ingredient for treating problem skin.

azelaic-acid.name: Azelaic Acid
azelaic-acid.description_en: Azelaic acid is a superstar acid with some serious magic properties. Before we list them out here's just a short intro.

alpha-arbutin.name: Alpha-Arbutin
alpha-arbutin.description_en: An opticalisomerof naturally occurringarbutin(or beta-arbutin). Just like its sibling, alpha-arbutin is also askin-brightening, depigmenting agent.

arbutin.name: Arbutin
arbutin.description_en: A pretty well-known and often used ingredient with the magic ability tofade brown spots. It's used traditionally in Japan andcan be found naturally ina couple ofplants, including the leaves of pear trees, wheat andbearberry.

ascorbic-acid.name: Ascorbic Acid
ascorbic-acid.description_en: If Vit C was a person it would be someone like Beyoncé, Jennifer Lopez or Mariah Carey. Serious performance,A-list superstarbut at the same time shows some major divaish behaviour.

ascorbyl-glucoside.name: Ascorbyl Glucoside
ascorbyl-glucoside.description_en: A form of skincare superstar,vitamin C. If you do not know why vitamin C is such a big deal in skincare, we have a reallydetailed, geeky descriptionthat's good to read. :)

sodium-ascorbyl-phosphate.name: Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate
sodium-ascorbyl-phosphate.description_en: The sodium saltform of skincare superstar,vitamin C. If you do not know what the big fuss about vitamin C is, you are missing out and you have toclick here and read all the geeky detailsabout it.

adenosine.name: Adenosine
adenosine.description_en: Adenosine is an important littlecompound in our bodythat has a vitalcell-signalling role. Research on smearing it on our face is also promising and shows so far a couple of things:

ectoin.name: Ectoin
ectoin.description_en: Ectoin is a surprisingly well-researched, multi-functional active that can do frompollution & lightprotectiontoskin hydration, soothing, andbarrier repair, several things to your skin.

hexylresorcinol.name: Hexylresorcinol
hexylresorcinol.description_en: Amoleculethat is naturally presentin the bran of ryeand other cereals. It has been used for a long time in the food industry as an "anti-browning agent" for fresh-cut fruits or shrimps.

zinc-pca.name: Zinc Pca
zinc-pca.description_en: If you have oily, acne-prone skin, Zinc PCA is one of the actives to put on your "TO TRY" list.

caffeine.name: Caffeine
caffeine.description_en: Hello, our favorite molecule that helps us wake up in the morning and then keeps us going through the day. As asuper well-known stimulant from coffee, tea and plenty of other soft drinks, Caffeine needs no introduction. So we will skip right to the part where we talk about what the hell it does in so-so many cosmetic products.

arginine.name: Arginine
arginine.description_en: A semi-essential (infants cannot synthesize it, but adults can)amino acidthat is one of the primary building blocks of hair keratin and skin collagen. It's anatural moisturizing factor, a skin hydrator and might also help tospeed up wound healing.

proline.name: Proline
proline.description_en: Anon-essential amino acid(meaning that our body can produce it) that's also one of the major building blocks of collagen.According to the Futurederm blog, it might be able toimprove wrinkleswhen combined with other amino acids, glycine and leucine

palmitoyl-tripeptide-1.name: Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1
palmitoyl-tripeptide-1.description_en: A reallyfamous peptide that is part of Matrixyl 3000, the most sold peptide complex in the word. Before we go and find out what the big deal with Matrixyl 3000 is, let's just focus on Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1 itself for a bit.

palmitoyl-tetrapeptide-7.name: Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7
palmitoyl-tetrapeptide-7.description_en: Afour amino acid peptidewith the amino sequence of glycine-glutamine-proline-arginine. It is attached to palmitic acid (a fatty acid)  to increase oil solubility and skin penetration.

palmitoyl-pentapeptide-4.name: Palmitoyl Pentapeptide-4
palmitoyl-pentapeptide-4.description_en: A pretty famous andbetter-researchedpeptideconsisting of five amino acids (the building blocks of all proteins). It was created in a joint effort by the French ingredient supplier, Sederma and the cosmetics industry big shot, Procter&Gamble.

acetyl-hexapeptide-3.name: Acetyl Hexapeptide-8
acetyl-hexapeptide-3.description_en: If you see a cosmetic product that claims that it has "Botox-like effect" then two things are almost certain: one, the product overpromises and two, it contains Argireline.

tripeptide-1.name: Tripeptide-1
tripeptide-1.description_en: A small, three amino acid (glycine-histidine-lysine or GHK) peptide that is famous for being atype I collagen fragment. The theory behind collagen-fragment peptides is that when collagen naturally breaks down in the skin, the resulting peptide fragments signal to the skin that it should get to work and create some nice, new collagen.

sh-oligopeptide-1.name: SH-Oligopeptide-1
sh-oligopeptide-1.description_en: Sh-Oligopeptide-1 is the famous molecule, which is also calledEpidermal Growth Factoror EGF. Chemically speaking, Growth Factors are largish peptides orsmallish proteins, or to put it in another way, medium-length amino acid sequences (EGF consists of 53 amino acids).  Biologically speaking, Growth Factors arecellular signal moleculesthat canstimulate cell growth, proliferation, healingand/or differentiation.

copper-tripeptide-1.name: Copper Tripeptide-1
copper-tripeptide-1.description_en: Compared to A-list skincare superstars (thinkvitamin C,glycolicorretinol), copper-tripeptide seems to be the new and exciting thing, but in fact, it has been around for a long time, since 1973 to be exact.

zinc-oxide.name: Zinc Oxide
zinc-oxide.description_en: When it comes to sunscreen agents,Zinc Oxide is pretty much in a league of its own. It's aphysical(or inorganic)sunscreenthat has a lot in common with fellow inorganic sunscreenTitanium Dioxide(TiO2) but a couple of things make it superior even to TiO2.

titanium-dioxide.name: Titanium Dioxide
titanium-dioxide.description_en: Titanium Dioxide isone of the two members of the elite sunscreen group called physical sunscreens(or inorganic sunscreens if you’re a science geek andwant to be precise).

tocopherol.name: Tocopherol
tocopherol.description_en: Vitamin E is themajor fat-soluble antioxidant in our skin. As a strong antioxidant it’s an A-player in protecting the skin cells from the nasty little things called free-radicals that want to destroy the lovely collagen that makes our skin nice and firm.

tocopheryl-acetate.name: Tocopheryl Acetate
tocopheryl-acetate.description_en: It’s themost commonly used version of pure vitamin Ein cosmetics.You can read all about the pure form here. This one is the so-called esterified version.

ferulic-acid.name: Ferulic Acid
ferulic-acid.description_en: Ferulic Acid (FA) is a goodie that can be found naturally in plant cell walls. There is a lot of it especially in the bran of grasses such as rice, wheat and oats.

resveratrol.name: Resveratrol
resveratrol.description_en: If you are looking for a reason why red wine is good for you, good news, you have found it! Resveratrol, aka the "red grape antioxidant" is the thing that's suspected to keep the French from coronary heart disease despite their not so healthy eating habits (such as high saturated fat intake).

ubiquinone.name: Ubiquinone
ubiquinone.description_en: Thanks to Nivea, Q10 is a pretty well-known ingredient and the fame and Beiersdorf's (the parent company of Nivea) obsession with it are not for no reason. It's anantioxidant found naturally in human cellswhere it plays a bigrole in energy production.

hydroxyacetophenone.name: Hydroxyacetophenone
hydroxyacetophenone.description_en: A handy multifunctional ingredient that works as apreservative booster, as well as anantioxidant and soothing agent.

ascorbyl-palmitate.name: Ascorbyl Palmitate
ascorbyl-palmitate.description_en: Aform of skincare superstar,vitamin C.Even though we are massive vitamin C fans,  Ascorbyl Palmitate  (AP) is our least favorite. (Btw, if you do not know what the big deal with vitamin C is then you are missing out. You must go and readour geeky detailsabout it.)

bht.name: BHT
bht.description_en: It's the acronym for Butylated Hydroxy Toluene. It's a common synthetic antioxidant that's used as apreservative.

allantoin.name: Allantoin
allantoin.description_en: Super commonsoothing ingredient. It can be found naturally in the roots & leaves of the comfrey plant, but more often than not what's in the cosmetic products is produced synthetically.

bisabolol.name: Bisabolol
bisabolol.description_en: It's one of theactive partsof Chamomilethat contains about 30% of bisabolol. It's a clear oily fluid that is used in skincare as a niceanti-inflammatory and soothingingredient.

centella-asiatica-extract.name: Centella Asiatica Extract
centella-asiatica-extract.description_en: Centella Asiatica - or sometimes also called Gotu Kola or Cica - has been used in folk medicine for hundreds of years. It’s traditionally used toimprove small wounds, burns and scratches and it’s also a well knownanti-inflammatory agentfor eczema.

asiaticoside.name: Asiaticoside
asiaticoside.description_en: One of the main biologically active components of the famous medicinal plant,Centella Asiatica, aka Gotu Kola. It has well establishedwound healing and antioxidant activities.

madecassoside.name: Madecassoside
madecassoside.description_en: One of the main biologically active components of the famous medicinal plant,Centella Asiatica, aka Gotu Kola. It has well establishedwound healing, skin-soothing and antioxidant activities.

dipotassium-glycyrrhizate.name: Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate
dipotassium-glycyrrhizate.description_en: The salt form of one of the main anti-inflammatory ingredients in the licorice plant, monoammonium glycyrrhizinate. It’s a yellowish powder with a nice sweet smell.

glycyrrhiza-glabra-root-extract.name: Glycyrrhiza Glabra  Root Extract
glycyrrhiza-glabra-root-extract.description_en: You might know licorice as a sweet treat from your childhood, but it's actually a legume that grows around the Mediterranean Sea, the Middle East, central and southern Russia. It's sweet and yellow and not only used for licorice all sorts but it's also askincare superstarthanks to two magic properties:

aloe-barbadensis-leaf-juice.name: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice
aloe-barbadensis-leaf-juice.description_en: Aloe Vera is one of today’s magic plants. It does have some very nice properties indeed, though famous dermatologist Leslie Baumann warns us in her book that most of the evidence is anecdotal and the plant might be a bit overhyped.

aloe-vera.name: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice
aloe-vera.description_en: Aloe Vera is one of today’s magic plants. It does have some very nice properties indeed, though famous dermatologist Leslie Baumann warns us in her book that most of the evidence is anecdotal and the plant might be a bit overhyped.

calendula-officinalis-extract.name: Calendula Officinalis Extract
calendula-officinalis-extract.description_en: The extract coming from the popular garden plant Calendula or Marigold. It's used traditionally as a skin-repairing and soothing plant extract.

camellia-sinensis-leaf-extract.name: Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract
camellia-sinensis-leaf-extract.description_en: We will tell you straight away that we are big green tea fans. Drinking it and slathering it all over your face are both great ideas. But as this is INCIDecoder and not a find-out-what’s-healthy-to-drink site we will now just focus on why you should put it on your face.

green-tea-extract.name: Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract
green-tea-extract.description_en: We will tell you straight away that we are big green tea fans. Drinking it and slathering it all over your face are both great ideas. But as this is INCIDecoder and not a find-out-what’s-healthy-to-drink site we will now just focus on why you should put it on your face.

oat-extract.name: Avena Sativa Kernel Extract
oat-extract.description_en: When you hear oatmeal, you probably think of breakfast, but the finely ground version of whole oat kernels, aka colloidal oatmeal, can dogoodthingsforyour skin, especially if it'sdry, itchy or prone to skin-rashes or eczema.

avena-sativa-kernel-extract.name: Avena Sativa Kernel Extract
avena-sativa-kernel-extract.description_en: When you hear oatmeal, you probably think of breakfast, but the finely ground version of whole oat kernels, aka colloidal oatmeal, can dogoodthingsforyour skin, especially if it'sdry, itchy or prone to skin-rashes or eczema.

beta-glucan.name: Beta-Glucan
beta-glucan.description_en: Beta-Glucan is a nice big molecule composed of many smaller sugar molecules (called polysaccharide). It’s in the cell walls of yeast, some mushrooms, seaweeds, and cereals.

ceramide-np.name: Ceramide NP
ceramide-np.description_en: One of the many types of ceramides that can be found naturally in the upper layer of the skin. Ceramides make up about 50% of the goopy stuff that's between our skin cells and play a superimportant role in having a healthy skin barrier and keeping the skin hydrated. It works even better when combined with its pal, Ceramide 1.

ceramide-ap.name: Ceramide AP
ceramide-ap.description_en: A type of ceramide that can be found naturally in the upper layer of the skin. Ceramides make up 50% of the goopy stuff that's between our skin cells and play asuper important role in having a healthy skin barrier and keeping the skin hydrated.

ceramide-eop.name: Ceramide EOP
ceramide-eop.description_en: Ceramides get quite a lot of hype recently and good news: there is a reason for that. But before we go into the details, let's just quickly define what the heck ceramides are:

ceramide-2.name: Ceramide NG
ceramide-2.description_en: One of the 9 types of ceramides that can be found naturally in the upper layer of the skin. Ceramides make up a big part (about 50%) of the goopy stuff that's between our skin cells (called extracellular matrix) and play a superimportant role in having a healthy skin barrier and keeping the skin hydrated.

ceramide-3.name: Ceramide NP
ceramide-3.description_en: One of the many types of ceramides that can be found naturally in the upper layer of the skin. Ceramides make up about 50% of the goopy stuff that's between our skin cells and play a superimportant role in having a healthy skin barrier and keeping the skin hydrated. It works even better when combined with its pal, Ceramide 1.

ceramide-6-ii.name: Ceramide AP
ceramide-6-ii.description_en: A type of ceramide that can be found naturally in the upper layer of the skin. Ceramides make up 50% of the goopy stuff that's between our skin cells and play asuper important role in having a healthy skin barrier and keeping the skin hydrated.

cholesterol.name: Cholesterol
cholesterol.description_en: It's one of the important lipids that can be found naturally in the outer layer of the skin. About25% of the goopy stuff between our skin cells consists of cholesterol. Together withceramidesand fatty acids, they play avital role in having a healthy skin barrierand keeping the skin hydrated.

phytosphingosine.name: Phytosphingosine
phytosphingosine.description_en: It's a type of lipid, a so-called sphingoid base thatcan be found naturally in the upper layer of the skin. It's found both in "free-form" and as part of famous skin lipids,ceramides.

butyl-methoxydibenzoylmethane.name: Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane
butyl-methoxydibenzoylmethane.description_en: The famous Avobenzone. It is a special snowflake as it isthe only globally available chemical sunscreen agent that provides proper UVA protection(in the US,new generation sunscreen agentsare not approved because of impossible FDA regulations). It is the global gold standard of UVA protection and is the most used UVA sunscreen in the world.

bis-ethylhexyloxyphenol-methoxyphenyl-tr.name: Bis-Ethylhexyloxyphenol Methoxyphenyl Triazine
bis-ethylhexyloxyphenol-methoxyphenyl-tr.description_en: ItsINCIname is abit of a mouthful, but Bis-Ethylhexyloxyphenol Methoxyphenyl Triazine is worth recognizing it as it isone of the best sunscreen agents known today. Unfortunately, it's not FDA-approved so you will not find it in sunscreens coming from the US (not because it's not good, but because US regulations make it impossible for newer sunscreen agents to get approved), but it is widely available in other parts of the world like Europe, Australia or Asia.

ethylhexyl-triazone.name: Ethylhexyl Triazone
ethylhexyl-triazone.description_en: Ethylhexyl Triazone is a new generation,chemical sunscreen(not available in the US due to impossible FDA regulations) that gives thehighest photo-stable absorption of all available UVB filterstoday. It protects in the UVB range (280-320nm) with a peak protection of 314nm. It is an oil soluble, odorless, colorless powder that works well in fragrance-free formulas. It can be used up to 5% worldwide except for the US and Canada.

phenylbenzimidazole-sulfonic-acid.name: Phenylbenzimidazole Sulfonic Acid
phenylbenzimidazole-sulfonic-acid.description_en: Achemical sunscreenagent that gives strongprotection in the UVB(280-320nm) range with its peak protection at 306 nm. Its special property is that unlike most sunscreen agents, it is not oil but water soluble, so it isideal to create light, oily skin compatibleformulas.  It is also fairly photostable and can be used to protect other less stable UV filters (like famous UVA blocker,avobenzone) in the formula. It is approved worldwide and can be used up to 4% in the US and up to 8% in the EU.

diethylamino-hydroxybenzoyl-hexyl-benzoa.name: Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate
diethylamino-hydroxybenzoyl-hexyl-benzoa.description_en: Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate is a new generation,chemical sunscreen agent(not available in the US due to impossible FDA regulations) that's designed forhigh UVA protection and high photostability. It gives sun protection in the whole UVA range (320-400 nm) with peak protection at 354nm. It can be used up to 10% worldwide except for the US and Canada.

methylene-bis-benzotriazolyl-tetramethyl.name: Methylene Bis-Benzotriazolyl Tetramethylbutylphenol
methylene-bis-benzotriazolyl-tetramethyl.description_en: The long name covers a nicesunscreen agentand quite a special one at that: It's a "hybrid" sunscreen meaning it's half-way between physical (the ones that, at least partly,reflect the sun) and chemical agents (that absorb the rays, which most sunscreens do).  It is anew generation UV filterand, just like its sister,Trinosorb S, it is not available in the US.

ethylhexyl-salicylate.name: Ethylhexyl Salicylate
ethylhexyl-salicylate.description_en: A colorless to light yellowish oily liquid that works as aUVB(280-320nm)sunscreen filterwith a peak absorbance at 306 nm. It'snot a strong filterin itself, it's always used in combination with other sunscreen agents to further enhance the SPF and tosolubilize other solid UV filters.

cetyl-alcohol.name: Cetyl Alcohol
cetyl-alcohol.description_en: A so-called fatty (the good, non-drying kind of) alcohol that does all kinds of things in a skincare product: it makes yourskin feel smooth and nice(emollient), helps tothicken up productsand also helps water and oil to blend (emulsifier). Can be derived from coconut or palm kernel oil.

stearyl-alcohol.name: Stearyl Alcohol
stearyl-alcohol.description_en: A handy multi-tasker, white to light yellowish oil-loving wax that works very well in oil-in-water emulsions.  Itmakes your skin feel nice and smooth(emollient),stabilizes oil-water mixesandgives bodyto them.

cetearyl-alcohol.name: Cetearyl Alcohol
cetearyl-alcohol.description_en: An extremely commonmultitaskeringredient that gives your skin anice soft feel(emollient) andgives body to creamsand lotions. It also helps to stabilize oil-water mixes (emulsions), though it does not function as an emulsifier in itself. Its typical use level in most cream type formulas is 2-3%.

behenyl-alcohol.name: Behenyl Alcohol
behenyl-alcohol.description_en: A fatty alcohol (the non-drying type with a long oil loving chain of 22 carbon atoms) that is used toincrease the viscosityof the formula and it also helps the oily and the watery parts to stay nicely mixed together (calledemulsion stabilizing).

arachidyl-alcohol.name: Arachidyl Alcohol
arachidyl-alcohol.description_en: A fatty alcohol (the non-drying type with a long oil loving chain of 20 carbon atoms) that is used toincrease the viscosity of the formulaand it also helps the oily and the watery parts to stay nicely mixed together (calledemulsion stabilizing).

octyldodecanol.name: Octyldodecanol
octyldodecanol.description_en: A clear, slightly yellow, odorless oil  that's a verycommon, medium-spreading emollient. It makes the skin feel nice and smooth and works in a wide range of formulas.

stearic-acid.name: Stearic Acid
stearic-acid.description_en: A commonmulti-tasker fatty acid. It makes your skin feel nice and smooth (emollient), gives body to cream type products and helps to stabilize water and oil mixes (aka emulsions).

palmitic-acid.name: Palmitic Acid
palmitic-acid.description_en: A fatty acid that can be found naturally in the skin. In fact, it's the most common saturated fatty acid found in animals and plants.

oleic-acid.name: Oleic Acid
oleic-acid.description_en: Acommon fatty acidthat can be found in lots of plant oils. Its name, "oleic", means derived fromolive oil, a plant oil rich in oleic acid, butavocado,macadamiaandmarulaoils, just to name a few, are also oleic rich.

linoleic-acid.name: Linoleic Acid
linoleic-acid.description_en: The famousomega-6 fatty acid,the mother of all ω-6 fatty acids in our body. It is a so-calledpolyunsaturatedfatty acid meaning it has more than one (in this case two) double bonds and a somewhat kinky structure that makes LA and LA-rich oils a thin liquid.

myristic-acid.name: Myristic Acid
myristic-acid.description_en: A 14 carbon length fatty acid that can be naturally found in nutmeg, palm kernel oil, coconut oil and butter fat. It's used as afoam building cleansing agent.Paula Begoun writesthat it can be a bit drying to the skin.

dimethicone.name: Dimethicone
dimethicone.description_en: Probably themost common siliconeof all. It is a polymer (created from repeating subunits) molecule and has different molecular weight and thus different viscosity versions from water-light to thick liquid.

phenyl-trimethicone.name: Phenyl Trimethicone
phenyl-trimethicone.description_en: A silicone fluid that gives anonoily, easy to spreademolliencyto the formulas. It is also used as a water repellent additive and to reduce the tackiness and stickiness of other ingredients. It also imparts gloss, softness and better manageability to hair.

dimethiconol.name: Dimethiconol
dimethiconol.description_en: Athick, high molecular weight siliconethat is usuallydiluted in another, lighter siliconefluid (likedimethiconeorcyclopentasiloxane). The dimethiconol containing silicone blendsleave a silky smooth, non-greasy filmon the skin.

squalane.name: Squalane
squalane.description_en: It seems to us that squalane is in fashion and there is a reason for it. Chemically speaking, it is a saturated  (no double bonds) hydrocarbon (a molecule consisting only of carbon and hydrogen), meaning that it's anice and stable oily liquidwith a long shelf life.

squalene.name: Squalene
squalene.description_en: Squalene is anoily liquidthat originally comes from shark liver but luckily it can also be found in a couple of plant oils. Olive (0.6%), peanut (0.1%) and pumpkin (0.35%) oils contain it, though not in huge amounts.

caprylic-capric-triglyceride.name: Caprylic/​Capric Triglyceride
caprylic-capric-triglyceride.description_en: A super commonemollientthatmakes your skin feel nice and smooth. It comes from coconut oil and glycerin, it’s light-textured, clear, odorless and non-greasy. It’s a nice ingredient that just feels good on the skin, is super well tolerated by every skin type and easy to formulate with. No wonder it’s popular.

coco-caprylate-caprate.name: Coco-Caprylate/​Caprate
coco-caprylate-caprate.description_en: A lightemollient ester(C8-10 fatty acids connected to C12-18 fatty alcohols) that absorbs quickly and leaves a dry butsilky finishon the skin. In terms of skin feel, it is similar toDicaprylyl Carbonate, another commonly used light emollient.

dicaprylyl-carbonate.name: Dicaprylyl Carbonate
dicaprylyl-carbonate.description_en: A clear, colorless, almost odorless oil that spreads nicely and easily andgives a velvet dry skin feel. It is good friends with sunscreen agents and helps to solubilize them. Also, it makes sunscreens feel lighter and spread easier.

dicaprylyl-ether.name: Dicaprylyl Ether
dicaprylyl-ether.description_en: A clear, colorless and odorless oily liquid that works as afast-spreading emollient with a dry skin feel.

c12-15-alkyl-benzoate.name: C12-15 Alkyl Benzoate
c12-15-alkyl-benzoate.description_en: An often usedemollient with a light and silky feel. It's very mild to both skin and eyes and spreads nicely and easily. It's often used in sunscreens as it's also an excellent solvent for sunscreen agents.

dibutyl-adipate.name: Dibutyl Adipate
dibutyl-adipate.description_en: A clear, colorless, odorless oily liquid that makes the formula easily spreadable and alsomakes the skin nice and smooth(emollient). It's especially helpful in sunscreens as it can help tosolubilize UV filters.

isononyl-isononanoate.name: Isononyl Isononanoate
isononyl-isononanoate.description_en: Anemollient ester with a rich and creamybut non-greasyskin feel. It makes skin supple and protects dry skin.

ethylhexyl-stearate.name: Ethylhexyl Stearate
ethylhexyl-stearate.description_en: A clear, almost colorless (or slightly yellowish) oily liquid (an ester to be precise) that's used as amedium spreading emollient. It gives skin a nice and smooth after-feel and it's very good at reducing oiliness or greasiness coming from other heavier oils in the formula.

diisopropyl-sebacate.name: Diisopropyl Sebacate
diisopropyl-sebacate.description_en: A clear, colorless, practically odorless, light liquid that works as ahandy helper ingredient in sunscreen formulas. Ithelps to create high-SPF formulas with reduced concentrations ofUV-filtersand it also helps to createcosmetically elegantformulas (and that's no easy feat when it comes to sunscreens). It absorbs rapidly, makes the product easily spreadable and reduces greasiness coming from the oil-soluble sunscreen agents.

triethylhexanoin.name: Triethylhexanoin
triethylhexanoin.description_en: Triethylhexanoin is a colorless to pale yellow liquid ester thatmakes the skin nice and smooth, aka emollient. It has a pleasantnon-sticky, non-greasy feelto it, gives formulassmooth applicationproperties and also helps moisture retention.

isopropyl-myristate.name: Isopropyl Myristate
isopropyl-myristate.description_en: A  clear, colorless oil-like liquid thatmakes the skin feel smooth and nice(aka emollient) and it does so without it being greasy.

isopropyl-palmitate.name: Isopropyl Palmitate
isopropyl-palmitate.description_en: A clear, colorlessemollient ester(oily liquid from isopropyl alcohol + palmitic acid) that makes the skin nice and smooth. It has very good spreading properties and gives a silky touch to the products.

ethylhexyl-palmitate.name: Ethylhexyl Palmitate
ethylhexyl-palmitate.description_en: A super common, medium-spreadingemollientester thatgives richness to the formulaand a mild feel during rubout. It can be a replacement for mineral oil and is often combined with other emollients to achieve different sensorial properties.

pentaerythrityl-tetraethylhexanoate.name: Pentaerythrityl Tetraethylhexanoate
pentaerythrityl-tetraethylhexanoate.description_en: A high-molecular-weightemollient esterthat makes your skin nice and smooth. It leaves a non-oily, light, "wet" feel on the skin.

neopentyl-glycol-diheptanoate.name: Neopentyl Glycol Diheptanoate
neopentyl-glycol-diheptanoate.description_en: A clear, odorless,very light emollient esterthat helps to achieve light textures. It has great spreadability, a good slip, and asilky skin feel.  It's ideal to solubilize sunscreen agents and fragrances. It's also touted asa volatile(evaporates from the skin rather than absorbs into it)silicone alternative, especially to replaceCyclomethicone mixes.

butyrospermum-parkii-butter.name: Butyrospermum Parkii Butter
butyrospermum-parkii-butter.description_en: Unless you live under a rock you must have heard aboutshea butter. It's probably the most hyped up natural butter in skincare today. It comes from the seeds ofAfrican Shea or Karite Treesand used as amagic moisturizer and emollient.

simmondsia-chinensis-seed-oil.name: Simmondsia Chinensis Seed Oil
simmondsia-chinensis-seed-oil.description_en: Jojoba is a drought resistant evergreen shrub native to South-western North America. It's known and grown for jojoba oil, the golden yellow liquid coming from the seeds (about 50% of the weight of the seeds will be oil).

argania-spinosa-kernel-oil.name: Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil
argania-spinosa-kernel-oil.description_en: When it comes to cosmetic oils and hype, argan oil is for sure leading the way. Dubbed as the "liquid gold of Morocco", we have to admit we have some trouble determining why this oil enjoys such a special miracle status. Not that it's not good, it is good, even great but reading the research about argan and a bunch of other plant oils we just do not see the big, unique differentiating factor (though that might be our fault not reading enough, obvs.)

helianthus-annuus-seed-oil.name: Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil
helianthus-annuus-seed-oil.description_en: Sunflower does not need a big intro as you probably use it in the kitchen as cooking oil, or you munch on the seeds as a healthy snack or you adore its big, beautiful yellow flower during the summer - or you do all of these and probably even more. And by even more  we mean putting it all over your face as sunflower oil isone of the most commonly used plant oils in skincare.

rosa-canina-fruit-oil.name: Rosa Canina Fruit Oil
rosa-canina-fruit-oil.description_en: Though it says fruit oil in its name, the rosehip fruit contains the seeds that contain the oil. So this one is the same asRosa Canina Seed Oil,  or Rosehip Oil, known for itshigh omega fatty acid content(linoleic acid - 51%, linolenic acid - 19% and oleic acid - 20%) andskin-regenerative properties.

prunus-amygdalus-dulcis-oil.name: Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis Oil
prunus-amygdalus-dulcis-oil.description_en: Theemollient plant oilthat comesfrom almonds. Similar to other plant oils, it is loaded with skin-nourishing fatty acids (oleic acid- 55-86% andlinoleic acid7-35%) and contains several other skin goodies such as antioxidantvitamin E and vitamin Bversions.

vitis-vinifera-seed-oil.name: Vitis Vinifera Seed Oil
vitis-vinifera-seed-oil.description_en: A goodie plant oil coming from the polyphenol-rich seeds of the grape. It's alight emollient oilthat makes your skin feel smooth and nice and alsocontains a bunch of good-for-the-skin stuff. It's a great source ofantioxidant polyphenols, barrier repairfatty acid linoleic acid(about 55-77%, while oleic acid is about 12-27%) and antioxidant, skin-protectantvitamin E.

persea-gratissima-oil.name: Persea Gratissima Oil
persea-gratissima-oil.description_en: The oil coming from the pulp of one of the most nutritious fruits in the world, the avocado. It's loaded with thenourishing and moisturizing fatty acid,oleic(70%) and contains some others includingpalmitic(10%) andlinoleicacid (8%). It also contains a bunch ofminerals and vitamins A,Eand D.

macadamia-ternifolia-seed-oil.name: Macadamia Ternifolia Seed Oil
macadamia-ternifolia-seed-oil.description_en: The golden yellow oil coming from the Macadamia nut, a native Australian nut. Similar to other plant oils, it'sloaded with emollient and nourishing fatty acids. It's ahigh oleic acid oil(50-67% oleic acid and only 0-5% linoleic acid) that makes it very emollient andideal for dry skin types(and less ideal for acne-prone skin).

calophyllum-inophyllum-seed-oil.name: Calophyllum Inophyllum Seed Oil
calophyllum-inophyllum-seed-oil.description_en: A green-yellowish oil coming from cool places like Tahiti, Bora Bora, and the island of Polynesia. Similar to other more common plant oils, it's loaded withnourishing and moisturizingfatty acids (oleic acid: 30-55%,linoleic acid: 15-45%,palmitic acid: 5-20% andstearic acid: 5-25%).

hippophae-rhamnoides-oil.name: Hippophae Rhamnoides Fruit Oil
hippophae-rhamnoides-oil.description_en: The oil coming from the pulp of the sea buckthorn berry. It has a pretty unique fatty acid composition: 65% is a combination of the rareOmega-7, aka palmitoleic acidand the more commonpalmitic acid. Fatty acids give the oil nicemoisturizing and skin-protectingabilities.

cocos-nucifera-oil.name: Cocos Nucifera Oil
cocos-nucifera-oil.description_en: There is definitely some craze going on for coconut oil both in the healthy eating space (often claimed to be the healthiest oil to cook with but this is a topic for another site) and in the skin and hair care space.

theobroma-cacao-seed-butter.name: Theobroma Cacao Seed Butter
theobroma-cacao-seed-butter.description_en: Theobroma means "food of the gods" in Greek though probably "treat of the people" would be more spot on. The cacao fruits and especially the seeds in it need no introduction as everyone knows them as the magical raw material of the magical sweet treat, chocolate (the flavour is composed of more than 1200(!) substances, and the exact chemical nature of it is not really understood, so it's indeed magic. :)).

coco-caprylate.name: Coco-Caprylate
coco-caprylate.description_en: A clear, colorless to slightly yellowish oil thatmakes the skin nice and smooth(emollient), spreads easily on the skin and is marketed as agood alternative to volatile(does not absorb into the skin but rather evaporates from it)siliconeslikeCyclomethicone.

meadowfoam-seed-oil.name: Limnanthes Alba Seed Oil
meadowfoam-seed-oil.description_en: Theemollient plant oilcoming from the seeds of the white flowering plant calledmeadowfoam.  Meadowfoam Oil has a unique fatty acid composition with95% of it being long chain fatty acids(eicosenoic acidC20:1 - 61%,docosenoicacidC22:1 - 16% anddocosadienoic acidC22:2 - 18%) that make the oilextraordinarily stable. It alsocontains antioxidant componentssuch asvitaminE as well asphytosterols.

limnanthes-alba-seed-oil.name: Limnanthes Alba Seed Oil
limnanthes-alba-seed-oil.description_en: Theemollient plant oilcoming from the seeds of the white flowering plant calledmeadowfoam.  Meadowfoam Oil has a unique fatty acid composition with95% of it being long chain fatty acids(eicosenoic acidC20:1 - 61%,docosenoicacidC22:1 - 16% anddocosadienoic acidC22:2 - 18%) that make the oilextraordinarily stable. It alsocontains antioxidant componentssuch asvitaminE as well asphytosterols.

rosehip-oil.name: Rosa Canina Seed Oil
rosehip-oil.description_en: Theoilcomingfrom the seeds ofdog-rose, a wild rose species native to Europe, northwest Africa and western Asia. It's a niceemollient, moisturizing plant oil loaded with skin-nourishing fatty acids(linoleic acid - 51%, linolenic acid - 19% and oleic acid - 20%).

marula-oil.name: Sclerocarya Birrea  Seed Oil
marula-oil.description_en: If you have an interest in elephants and Africa, you have probably heard of elephants getting drunk from the fruit of the Marula tree. Thoughthis seems to be only a legend, what is true is that theMarula fruitis really nice (and elephants do love to eat it) and there is a stone in it withseveral oil-rich kernelsinside.

glyceryl-stearate.name: Glyceryl Stearate
glyceryl-stearate.description_en: A super common, waxy, white, solid stuff thathelps water and oil to mix together, gives body to creams and leaves the skin feeling soft and smooth.

peg-100-stearate.name: PEG-100 Stearate
peg-100-stearate.description_en: A very commonwater-loving surfactant and emulsifierthat helps to keep water and oil mixed nicely together.

cetearyl-glucoside.name: Cetearyl Glucoside
cetearyl-glucoside.description_en: Asugar based emulsifierthat's especially great for low viscosity lotions or even sprays. It's effective in small amounts, only 1-1.5% is needed to form an emulsion. The resulting cream or lotion has great cosmetic properties with good spreadability and an enhanced soft skin feel.

polysorbate-20.name: Polysorbate 20
polysorbate-20.description_en: It's a common little helper ingredient thathelps water and oil to mixtogether. Also, it can help toincrease the solubilityof some other ingredients in the formula.

polysorbate-60.name: Polysorbate 60
polysorbate-60.description_en: A common little helper ingredient thathelps water and oil to mixtogether, aka emulsifier.

polysorbate-80.name: Polysorbate 80
polysorbate-80.description_en: A common little helper ingredient thathelps water and oil to mixtogether, aka emulsifier.

sorbitan-stearate.name: Sorbitan Stearate
sorbitan-stearate.description_en: A popular,vegetable-derived oil-loving emulsifierthat helps water to mix with oil. In itself, it is suitable for water-in-oil emulsions (where water droplets are dispersed in oil), but it is more often used as a co-emulsifier next to other, water-loving emulsifiers.

sorbitan-oleate.name: Sorbitan Oleate
sorbitan-oleate.description_en: A mainly oil-loving, vegetable raw material based ingredient that helps water and oil to mix together, akaemulsifier. It can also function as awetting and dispersing agenthelping insoluble particles such as color pigments or inorganic sunscreens (zinc/titanium dioxide) to disperse nice and even in liquids.

sorbitan-sesquioleate.name: Sorbitan Sesquioleate
sorbitan-sesquioleate.description_en: A mainly oil loving molecule that helps water and oil to mix nicely, akaemulsifier. In itself, it can create water-in-oil emulsions (when water droplets are dispersed in oil), but it is used mostly next to water-loving emulsifiers to create nice and smooth oil-in-water creams.  It can also function as awetting and dispersing agenthelping insoluble particles such as color pigments or inorganic sunscreens (zinc/titanium dioxide) to disperse nice and even in liquids.

sodium-stearoyl-glutamate.name: Sodium Stearoyl Glutamate
sodium-stearoyl-glutamate.description_en: Anamino acid-based emulsifierthat helps water and oil to mix and stay that way. It is considered as natural, environmentally friendly, and hypoallergenic.

steareth-2.name: Steareth-2
steareth-2.description_en: A waxy solid material that helps oil and water to mix together, akaemulsifier. It is derived from the fatty alcohol,stearyl alcoholby ethoxylating it and thus making the molecule a little water-soluble. This version has only a small amount of ethoxylation and thus the molecule is still largely oil soluble. It is often mixed with more water-soluble emulsifiers (such asSteareth-20) to create stable emulsion systems.

steareth-21.name: Steareth-21
steareth-21.description_en: A waxy solid material that helps oil and water to mix together, akaemulsifier. It is super similar toSteareth-20with just a little more ethoxylation and thus a little more water solubility. It works very well when combined with mostly oil-soluble emulsifiers such asSteareth-2and the two together can form exceptionally stable emulsions.

lecithin.name: Lecithin
lecithin.description_en: A very common ingredient that can be found in all cell membranes. In cosmetics it's quite the multi-tasker: it's anemollientandwater-bindingingredient but it's also anemulsifierand can be used forstabilizationpurposes. It's also often used tocreate liposomes.

hydrogenated-lecithin.name: Hydrogenated Lecithin
hydrogenated-lecithin.description_en: It's the chemically chopped up version of normallecithin. Most often it'sused to create liposomesand to coat and stabilize other ingredients.

polyglyceryl-3-methylglucose-distearate.name: Polyglyceryl-3 Methylglucose Distearate
polyglyceryl-3-methylglucose-distearate.description_en: Avegetable-based emulsifierthat helps the oily and watery parts of the formula to mix nicely together. It is compatible with a bunch of cosmetic oils as well as active ingredients and its specialty is creating emulsions with super high heat and freeze stability (from -25 °C and +50 °C).

peg-40-hydrogenated-castor-oil.name: PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil
peg-40-hydrogenated-castor-oil.description_en: A mildly viscous, amber-colored liquid with fatty odor, made from Castor Oil and polyethylene glycol (PEG).

behentrimonium-methosulfate.name: Behentrimonium Methosulfate
behentrimonium-methosulfate.description_en: In itself, it's anantistatic(stops your hair from flying around because of electricity),hair conditioningand softening ingredient used mainly in haircare products.

glyceryl-stearate-se.name: Glyceryl Stearate SE
glyceryl-stearate-se.description_en: An oily kind of ingredient that can magically blend with water all by itself. This is calledself-emulsifyingand SE in its name stands for that.

arachidyl-glucoside.name: Arachidyl Glucoside
arachidyl-glucoside.description_en: An ingredient that is created from the attachment of the water-loving sugar molecule,glucose, and an oil-loving 20 carbon long fatty chain. This makes it a partly water- and partly oil-soluble material, meaning it functions as anemulsifier helping oil and water to mix.

glyceryl-oleate.name: Glyceryl Oleate
glyceryl-oleate.description_en: The attachment ofglycerinandoleic acidthat works mainly as aco-emulsifier and stabilizerto create stable water-oil mixes, aka emulsions. It is also popular in cleansing products as it helps tothicken them upand has somerefattingand skin-smoothing effect.

ceteareth-20.name: Ceteareth-20
ceteareth-20.description_en: A common functional ingredient that helps tokeep the oil-loving and water-loving ingredients together(emulsifier), stabilizes and thickens the products.

phenoxyethanol.name: Phenoxyethanol
phenoxyethanol.description_en: It’s pretty much the current IT-preservative. It’ssafe and gentle, but even more importantly, it’s not a feared-by-everyone-mostly-without-scientific-reason paraben.

sodium-benzoate.name: Sodium Benzoate
sodium-benzoate.description_en: A helper ingredient that helps to make the products stay nice longer, akapreservative. It works mainly against fungi.

potassium-sorbate.name: Potassium Sorbate
potassium-sorbate.description_en: It's one of those things thathelp your cosmetics not to go wrong too soon, aka a preservative. It’s not a strong one and doesn’t really work against bacteria, but more against mold and yeast. To do that it has to break down to its active form, sorbic acid. For that to happen, there has to be water in the product and the right pH value (pH 3-4).

ethylhexylglycerin.name: Ethylhexylglycerin
ethylhexylglycerin.description_en: If you have spotted ethylhexylglycerin on the ingredient list, most probably you will see there also the current IT-preservative,phenoxyethanol. They are good friends because ethylhexylglycerin canboost the effectiveness of phenoxyethanol(and other preservatives) and as an added bonus it feels nice on the skin too.

caprylyl-glycol.name: Caprylyl Glycol
caprylyl-glycol.description_en: It’s a handymulti-tasking ingredientthat gives the skin anice, soft feel. At the same time, it alsoboosts the effectiveness of other preservatives, such as the nowadays super commonly usedphenoxyethanol.

1-2-hexanediol.name: 1,2-Hexanediol
1-2-hexanediol.description_en: A really multi-functional helper ingredient that can do several things in a skincare product: it can bring a soft and pleasant feel to the formula, it can act as ahumectant and emollient, it can be asolventfor some other ingredients (for example it can help to stabilize perfumes in watery products) and it can also help to disperse pigments more evenly in makeup products. And that is still not all: it can alsoboostthe antimicrobial activity ofpreservatives.

caprylhydroxamic-acid.name: Caprylhydroxamic Acid
caprylhydroxamic-acid.description_en: Achelating agentthat helps to preserve cosmetic products by neutralizing the metal ions (especially iron) in the formula (that usually get into there from water). Its special thing is that it also acts as abiostatic and fungistatic agentand remains active even at high pH.

chlorphenesin.name: Chlorphenesin
chlorphenesin.description_en: A little helper ingredient that works as a preservative. It works against bacteria and some species of fungi and yeast. It's often combined with IT-preservative,phenoxyethanol.

dehydroacetic-acid.name: Dehydroacetic Acid
dehydroacetic-acid.description_en: A helper ingredient that helps to make the products stay nice longer, akapreservative. It works mainly against fungi and has only milder effect against bacteria.

benzoic-acid.name: Benzoic Acid
benzoic-acid.description_en: An Ecocert-approved,natural preservativethat counts as gentle and non-irritating to the skin. Usually, it comes to the formula as part of a preservative blend as it's not enough on its own.

sorbic-acid.name: Sorbic Acid
sorbic-acid.description_en: Amild, natural preservativethat usually comes to the formula together with its other mild preservative friends, such asBenzoic Acidand/orDehydroacetic Acid. Btw, it's also used as a food preservative.

glyceryl-caprylate.name: Glyceryl Caprylate
glyceryl-caprylate.description_en: A 100% plant derived, natural (Ecocert approved) multi-functional ingredient that hasemollient and moisturizingproperties, can work as aco-emulsifier(meaning that next to other emulsifiers it can help water and oil to mix)  and even more importantly has astrong antimicrobial activity.

benzyl-alcohol.name: Benzyl Alcohol
benzyl-alcohol.description_en: It's one of those things that help your cosmetics not to go wrong too soon, aka apreservative. It can be naturally found in fruits and teas but can also be made synthetically.

carbomer.name: Carbomer
carbomer.description_en: A big molecule created from repeated subunits (a polymer of acrylic acid) that magicallyconverts a liquid into a nice gel formula.  It usually has to be neutralized with a base (such assodium hydroxide) for the thickening to occur and itcreates viscous, clear gelsthat also feel nice and non-tacky on the skin. No wonder, it is a very popular and common ingredient. Typically used at 1% or less in most formulations.

xanthan-gum.name: Xanthan Gum
xanthan-gum.description_en: It's one of the most commonly usedthickeners andemulsion stabilizers. If the product is too runny, a little xanthan gum will make it more gel-like. Used alone, it can make the formula sticky and it is a good team player so it is usually combined with other thickeners and so-called rheology modifiers (helper ingredients that adjust the flow and thus the feel of the formula). The typical use level of Xantha Gum is below 1%, it is usually in the 0.1-0.5% range.

hydroxyethylcellulose.name: Hydroxyethylcellulose
hydroxyethylcellulose.description_en: A nice little helper ingredient that canthicken up cosmetic productsand create beautiful gel formulas. It's derived from cellulose, the major component of the cell wall of green plants. It is compatible with most co-ingredients and gives a very good slip to the formulas.

hydroxypropyl-methylcellulose.name: Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose
hydroxypropyl-methylcellulose.description_en: A handy helper ingredient (a polymer, i.e. big molecule from repeated subunits) that is used tostabilize emulsions as well as to thicken up products. It can also stabilize foam in cleansing products.

carrageenan.name: Carrageenan
carrageenan.description_en: A natural polysaccharide (big sugar molecule) coming from red edible seaweeds. It is used as a helper ingredient for itsgelling, thickening and stabilizing properties.

microcrystalline-cellulose.name: Microcrystalline Cellulose
microcrystalline-cellulose.description_en: Cellulose is an important component of the cell walls of green plants and it's themost abundant natural polymer(big molecule from repeated subunits) on Earth. If the polymer structure is not too big (less than 200 repeated units), cellulose becomes microcrystalline cellulose.

sodium-polyacrylate.name: Sodium Polyacrylate
sodium-polyacrylate.description_en: Asuperabsorbent polymer(big molecule from repeated subunits) that has crazy water binding abilities. Sometimes its referred to as "waterlock" and can absorb 100 to 1000 times its mass in water.

acrylates-c10-30-alkyl-acrylate-crosspol.name: Acrylates/​C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer
acrylates-c10-30-alkyl-acrylate-crosspol.description_en: Though its long name does not reveal it, this polymer molecule (big molecule from repeated subunits or monomers) is a relative to the super common, water-loving thickener,Carbomer. Both of them are big molecules that contain acrylic acid units, but Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer also contains some other monomers that are hydrophobic, i.e. water-hating.

hydroxyethyl-acrylate-sodium-acryloyldim.name: Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/​Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer
hydroxyethyl-acrylate-sodium-acryloyldim.description_en: This long-named, polymer molecule (big molecule from repeated subunits) is a helper ingredient that's good atemulsifying and stabilizing oils into water-based formulas.It also acts as athickening and gelling agentthatcreates nice, non-sticky and supple textures. It works over a very wide pH range (3-12) and can be used to thicken up low-ph formulas, such as exfoliants. Its recommended used range is 0.3-3%.

acrylates-copolymer.name: Acrylates Copolymer
acrylates-copolymer.description_en: A big polymer molecule that has a bunch of different versions and thus different uses. It can act as afilm former,asathickening agent,or it canincrease the water-resistance in sunscreens. It is also used to entrap pigments/inorganic sunscreens within a micron size matrix for even coverage and easy application.

cellulose.name: Cellulose
cellulose.description_en: A natural polymer (big molecule from repeated subunits) that can be found in the cell wall of green plants. It is a natural and sustainable helper ingredient that canimprove the absorptionof the formula and it alsoreduces oilinesson the skin. It is also used as asensory additive and thickening agent.

silica.name: Silica
silica.description_en: A white powdery thing that's the major component of glass and sand. In cosmetics, it’s often in products that are supposed tokeep your skin matteas it has great oil-absorbing abilities. It’s also used as a helper ingredient tothicken up productsor suspend insoluble particles.

silica-dimethyl-silylate.name: Silica Dimethyl Silylate
silica-dimethyl-silylate.description_en: It's a water-hating,fumed silicathat works as athickener for oilsand it can alsosuspend particles in oils.

magnesium-aluminum-silicate.name: Magnesium Aluminum Silicate
magnesium-aluminum-silicate.description_en: A type of clay mineral that works as a nice helper ingredient tothicken and stabilize formulas. As a clay, it consists of platelets that have a negative charge on the surface (face) and a positive on the edge. So the face of one platelet attracts the edge of the other and this builds a so-called "house of card" structure meaning that Magnesium Aluminum Silicate (MAS)thickens up products and helps to suspend non-soluble particlessuch as color pigments or inorganic sunscreens (zinc oxideandtitanium dioxide).

kaolin.name: Kaolin
kaolin.description_en: Kaolin is atype of clayor to be precise, a naturally occurring hydrous aluminum silicate. When you hear clay, you probably think of a muddy greenish-black mess, but that one isbentonite, and this one is a fine, white powder. It is so white that it's also often used, in small amounts, as a helper ingredient togive opacity and whitenessto the cosmetic formulas.

talc.name: Talc
talc.description_en: Talc is themajor component of most powder makeup products(think face powder, eyeshadows, and blushers) that usually contain it up to 70%. Its two winning properties that make it very suitable for this role is itsoutstanding spreadabilityfor a smooth application and itslow covering power, aka translucencyto avoid clown-like effects.

mica.name: Mica
mica.description_en: A super versatile and commonmineral powderthat comes in different particle sizes. It is amulti-taskerused to improve skin feel,increase product slip, give the product light-reflecting properties, enhance skin adhesionor serve as ananti-caking agent.

nylon-12.name: Nylon-12
nylon-12.description_en: An  odorless, slightly yellowish powder that's used as a polymer microsphere (a tiny little ball from repeated subunits). It gives products an elegant,silky textureand better slip. It can alsoscatter light to blur fine lineswhile letting enough light through so that the skin still looks natural.

trimethylsiloxysilicate.name: Trimethylsiloxysilicate
trimethylsiloxysilicate.description_en: Asolid silicone resinthat creates a permeable film over the skin. It makes makeup formulas morelong-lastingand can enhance thewater resistanceof sunscreens. It leaves a non-tacky film when dried.

tapioca-starch.name: Tapioca Starch
tapioca-starch.description_en: A soft, white powder that can be used as atalcreplacementin body powders or in pressed powders. It also has someoil absorbingproperties and givesincreased cushion and richness to emulsion-type formulas.

copernicia-cerifera-cera.name: Copernicia Cerifera Wax
copernicia-cerifera-cera.description_en: Avegetable waxcoming from the leaves of the Brazilian tropical palm tree,Copernicia cerifera.Similar to other waxes, it is used tostabilize and give body to products, or to keep stick type formulas solid. It is thehardest natural waxwith a high melting point (around 85C) and high gloss making it a great wax choice for lip products.

candelilla-cera.name: Candelilla Cera
candelilla-cera.description_en: Avegetable waxcoming from the leaves of the North Mexican candelilla shrubs (Euphorbia cerifera and Euphorbia antisyphilitica).  Similar to other waxes, it is used tostabilize products and give body to them, or to keep stick type formulas solid. It has a melting point around 70C and has high gloss making it a good choice for lip products.

cera-alba.name: Cera Alba
cera-alba.description_en: It's the yellow, solid stuff that you probably know from beeswax candles. It's a natural materialproduced by honey beesto build their honeycomb.

cera-flava.name: Cera Alba
cera-flava.description_en: It's the yellow, solid stuff that you probably know from beeswax candles. It's a natural materialproduced by honey beesto build their honeycomb.

carnauba.name: Copernicia Cerifera Wax
carnauba.description_en: Avegetable waxcoming from the leaves of the Brazilian tropical palm tree,Copernicia cerifera.Similar to other waxes, it is used tostabilize and give body to products, or to keep stick type formulas solid. It is thehardest natural waxwith a high melting point (around 85C) and high gloss making it a great wax choice for lip products.

sodium-hydroxide.name: Sodium Hydroxide
sodium-hydroxide.description_en: The unfancy name for it is lye. It’s a solid white stuff that’svery alkalineand used in small amounts toadjust the pH of the productand make it just right.

potassium-hydroxide.name: Potassium Hydroxide
potassium-hydroxide.description_en: It's a very alkaline stuff that helps toset the pH of the cosmetic formulato be just right. It's similar to the more often usedsodium hydroxideand pretty much the same of what we wrote there applies here too.

triethanolamine.name: Triethanolamine
triethanolamine.description_en: It’s a little helper ingredient that helps toset the pH of a cosmeticformulation to be just right. It’s very alkaline (you know the opposite of being very acidic): a 1% solution has a pH of around 10.

aminomethyl-propanol.name: Aminomethyl Propanol
aminomethyl-propanol.description_en: An alkaline (high pH, aka basic) material that is used toset the pH of the cosmetic formula to the right value.

citric-acid.name: Citric Acid
citric-acid.description_en: Citric acid comes from citrus fruits and is an AHA. If these magic three letters don’t tell you anything,click hereand read our detailed description on glycolic acid, the most famous AHA.

lactic-acid.name: Lactic Acid
lactic-acid.description_en: Lactic acid is thesecondmost well-known andmost well researched among the AHAs. The no. 1 is glycolic acid. If you're new to AHAs we strongly suggest that you head over to ourdescription about glycolic acid. There you will find a super detailed geeky description and many of the things we wrote are true to all AHAs and to lactic acid as well.

malic-acid.name: Malic Acid
malic-acid.description_en: Malic acidcomes from apple and is an AHA. If these magic three letters don’t tell you anything,click here and read our detailed description on glycolic acid, the most famous AHA.

disodium-edta.name: Disodium EDTA
disodium-edta.description_en: Super common little helper ingredient thathelps products to remain nice and stable for a longer time. It does so by neutralizing the metal ions in the formula (that usually get into there from water) that would otherwise cause some not so nice changes.

trisodium-edta.name: Trisodium EDTA
trisodium-edta.description_en: A common helper ingredient that works as a so-called chelating agent.  Ithelps products to remain nice and stable for a longer timeby neutralizing the metal ions in the formula (that usually get into there from water) that would otherwise cause some not so nice changes.

tetrasodium-edta.name: Tetrasodium EDTA
tetrasodium-edta.description_en: A handy helper ingredient thathelps products to remain nice and stable for a longer time. It does so by neutralizing the metal ions in the formula (that usually get into there from water) that would otherwise cause some not so nice changes.

trisodium-ethylenediamine-disuccinate.name: Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate
trisodium-ethylenediamine-disuccinate.description_en: A helper ingredient that helps toneutralize the metal ionsin the formula (they usually come from water) so it stays nice longer. The special property of this particular ingredient is that it's more effective against more problematic ions, like Cu (copper) and Fe (iron) compared to less problematic ones like Ca (calcium)  and Mg (magnesium).

phytic-acid.name: Phytic Acid
phytic-acid.description_en: Though its name says acid, it's not really an exfoliant. It's aplant extractwithsome antioxidantproperties. Its main thing in cosmetic products is toneutralize the metal ionsin the formula (that usually get into there from water) that would otherwise cause some not so nice changes.  It's a natural alternative to sometimes bad-mouthed chelating agents,EDTAs.

sodium-phytate.name: Sodium Phytate
sodium-phytate.description_en: It’s one of those little helper ingredients thatmakes sure the product stays the same over time. No color change or anything like that. It does so by neutralizing the metal ions in the formula (that usually get into there from water) that would otherwise cause some not so nice changes.

glycolic-acid.name: Glycolic Acid
glycolic-acid.description_en: Unless you have avoided every bit of skin care info out there so far (in this case special welcome to you! :)) you must have heard of glycolic acid. Or at least aboutAHAs or to put it even more nice-soundingfruit acids.

mandelic-acid.name: Mandelic Acid
mandelic-acid.description_en: An AHA,thatcomes from bitter almondand is named after the German name of almond, “mandel”. If you have never heard of AHAs (where have you been? :)) then go ahead andread all about the most famous representative, glycolic acid. We will wait. When it comes to skincare you have to know about AHAs. Sogo and read it, and let’s meet here afterward.

gluconolactone.name: Gluconolactone
gluconolactone.description_en: Gluconolactone iskind of an acid, even though you would probably not guess it from its name. It’s aPHA, or polyhydroxy acid. PHAs are close relatives to the famous AHAs, both in terms of similar chemical structure and similar effects on the skin. They are oftenmarketed as new-generation AHAs. So if AHAs do not tell you anything,you can read all about them here. Go and read. We tell you, it’s worth the time.

lactobionic-acid.name: Lactobionic Acid
lactobionic-acid.description_en: Lactobionic acid is the brother or maybe the sister ofgluconolactone. Usually, it’s called a PHA, though some studies call it bionic acid or aldobionic acid. Not that this matters too much. What matters is that it’s similarly awesome to gluconolactone. Sogo read about gluconolactoneto get the idea.

hydrolyzed-collagen.name: Hydrolyzed Collagen
hydrolyzed-collagen.description_en: Thechemically chopped up version of the big protein molecule, collagen. It is often derived from fish or bovine sources and works as anice moisturizer and humectantthat helps the skin to hold onto water.

hydrolyzed-wheat-protein.name: Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein
hydrolyzed-wheat-protein.description_en: A chemically chopped up version of wheat protein that consists mainly of amino acids (the building blocks), peptides (a couple of amino acids together), and proteins (lots of amino acids together).

glycine.name: Glycine
glycine.description_en: A non-essential amino acid (the building blocks of skin proteins, like collagen or elastin), that the body can produce itself, but its production decreases with age. When you put it all over your face, itworks as a moisturizerand maybe more.

serine.name: Serine
serine.description_en: Serine is anamino acidthat most often comes to the formula as part of amoisturizingcomplex. It's a non-essential amino acid (meaning that our body can synthesize it) and serves as a water-binding ingredient.

threonine.name: Threonine
threonine.description_en: Anessential amino acidthat's also a key building block of collagen and elastin. When taken orally, it helps the digestive and intestinal tracts function more smoothly and also helps the absorption of nutrients. As for skincare, it is not clear what it does other than being askinhydrator.

laureth-23.name: Laureth-23
laureth-23.description_en: A white waxy solid thathelps water and oil to mix nicely together(emulsifier). It is derived from the fatty alcohol lauryl alcohol by ethoxylating it and thus making the molecule a lot more water-soluble. In fact, Laureth-23 is mostly water-soluble acting as asolubilizerfor dissolving small amounts of oily things into water-based formulas.

biosaccharide-gum-1.name: Biosaccharide Gum-1
biosaccharide-gum-1.description_en: Biosaccharide Gum-1 is a pretty interesting kind of sugar ingredient that is created fromsorbitolvia bacterial fermentation.

opuntia-ficus-indica-extract.name: Opuntia Ficus-Indica Extract
opuntia-ficus-indica-extract.description_en: Prickly pear is a cactus that’s native to Mexico. It has large, sweet fruit that’s called tunas and has been used as a source of food since pre-Hispanic Mexico. Currently jams and jellies are produced from it and also a traditional Mexican alcoholic drink calledcolonche.

saccharomyces-cerevisiae-extract.name: Saccharomyces Cerevisiae Extract
saccharomyces-cerevisiae-extract.description_en: Usually different kind of yeast extracts are used in skincare for their great hydrating, and general skin conditioning properties. We could find one research paper to back this up: It has found that SC indeedincreases skin moistureand had improvedskin microrelief(the small wrinkles and surface irregularities of skin).

limonene.name: Limonene
limonene.description_en: A supercommon and cheap fragrance ingredient. It's in many plants, e.g. rosemary, eucalyptus, lavender, lemongrass, peppermint and it's the main component (about 50-90%) of the peel oil of citrus fruits.

linalool.name: Linalool
linalool.description_en: Linalool is asuper common fragranceingredient. It’s kind of everywhere - both in plants and in cosmetic products. It’s part of 200 natural oils including lavender, ylang-ylang, bergamot, jasmine, geranium and it can be found in 90-95% of prestige perfumes on the market.

citronellol.name: Citronellol
citronellol.description_en: Citronellol is a very commonfragranceingredient with a nicerose-like odor. In the UK, it’s actually the third most often listed perfume on the ingredient lists.

saccharomyces-ferment-filtrate.name: Saccharomyces Ferment Filtrate
saccharomyces-ferment-filtrate.description_en: Saccharomyces Ferment Filtrate is the fancy name of a liquidy, almost-water-like stuff that you get by fermenting and filtering yeast.

bifida-ferment-lysate.name: Bifida Ferment Lysate
bifida-ferment-lysate.description_en: Bifida Ferment Lysate is aprobiotic ingredientthat’s used in one of the most iconic serums in the world, the Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repair.Based on manufacturer infoit potentlyprotects against UV-induced damagein the skin and helps with DNA repair. AnEstee Lauder patentfrom 2009 also talks aboutDNA repair activity.

lactococcus-ferment-lysate.name: Lactococcus Ferment Lysate
lactococcus-ferment-lysate.description_en: Lactococcus Ferment Lysate is a fairly newprobiotic ingredientthat is obtained from the Gram-positive bacteria, Lactococcus lactis. The lysate is a fluid substance that is produced when you break down the cell membrane, which means it contains interesting things including cytoplasm and cell wall fragments.

palmitoyl-grapevine-shoot-extract.name: Palmitoyl Grapevine Shoot Extract
palmitoyl-grapevine-shoot-extract.description_en: It’s a grape-derived ingredient that’s exclusive to French grape-centered skincare brand, Caudalie. Because of this there is not much independent info on it, but the brand claims that this is a very effective ingredient forfading brown spots.

parfum.name: Parfum/​Fragrance
parfum.description_en: Exactly what it sounds:nice smelling stuffput into cosmetic products so that the end product also smells nice.Fragrance in the US andparfumin the EUis ageneric termon the ingredient list that ismade up of 30 to 50 chemicalson average (but it can have as much as 200 components!).

cucumis-sativus-fruit-extract.name: Cucumis Sativus Fruit Extract
cucumis-sativus-fruit-extract.description_en: Cucumber is a nice, non-irritating plant extract that’s known for it’ssoothing and emollientproperties. It’s not something new to put it on our face: even Cleopatra used it to “preserve her skin”.

aesculus-hippocastanum-seed-extract.name: Aesculus Hippocastanum Seed Extract
aesculus-hippocastanum-seed-extract.description_en: Horse Chestnut is an often-used ingredient thanks to a couple of nice magic properties. It contains the active ingredient calledescinthat helps tomaintain healthy blood circulationandstrengthen capillaries. This makes horse chestnut useful for rosacea-prone skin and it’s also often used in toners for a fresh skin feeling.

arctostaphylos-uva-ursi-leaf-extract.name: Arctostaphylos Uva-Ursi Leaf Extract
arctostaphylos-uva-ursi-leaf-extract.description_en: Arctostaphylos Uva-Ursi is a little plant with nice red berries that lives in the North and is also called bearberry or kinnikinnick. According to Wikipedia the uva-ursi part means “grape of the bear”.

rubus-idaeus-fruit-extract.name: Rubus Idaeus Fruit Extract
rubus-idaeus-fruit-extract.description_en: Raspberry is one of the colorful berries that’s not only delicious but contains many biologically active, healthy compounds. It has polyphenols including anthocyanins and ellagitannins that haveantioxidant and anti-inflammatoryproperties.

buddleja-davidii-meristem-cell-culture.name: Buddleja Davidii Meristem Cell Culture
buddleja-davidii-meristem-cell-culture.description_en: The extract of summer lilac or  butterfly-bush in itself is a nice ingredient with someantioxidant and anti-inflammatoryproperties andthe manufacturer claimsthat the meristem cell culture is even better.

vitis-vinifera-juice-extract.name: Vitis Vinifera Juice Extract
vitis-vinifera-juice-extract.description_en: It's a liquid extract coming from grape.According to manufacturer info, it's askin peeling agent, aka exfoliant, that contains a nice mix of AHA acids (if those magic three letters do not tell you anything,you must click here now.)

sclerocarya-birrea-seed-oil.name: Sclerocarya Birrea  Seed Oil
sclerocarya-birrea-seed-oil.description_en: If you have an interest in elephants and Africa, you have probably heard of elephants getting drunk from the fruit of the Marula tree. Thoughthis seems to be only a legend, what is true is that theMarula fruitis really nice (and elephants do love to eat it) and there is a stone in it withseveral oil-rich kernelsinside.

galactoarabinan.name: Galactoarabinan
galactoarabinan.description_en: Galactoarabinan is anaturalpolysaccharide(a big carbohydrate molecule) that comes from the Larch trees.

methylpropanediol.name: Methylpropanediol
methylpropanediol.description_en: It's a type of glycol that -according to the manufacturer- is an extremely good replacement for other glycols likepropyleneorbutylene glycol. Its main job is to be asolvent, but it has also very goodantimicrobialproperties and acts as a truepreservative booster. Also helps with skin hydration without stickiness or tacky feel.

camellia-oleifera-leaf-extract.name: Camellia Oleifera  Leaf Extract
camellia-oleifera-leaf-extract.description_en: Camellia Oleifera is a type ofgreen teaplant that's mostly known for the oil that comes from its seeds. As for the leaves, it has similar properties as the better known and more often used Camellia Sinensis leaves. You can read all the geeky details about green tea  and why it's awesome byclicking here, but in short, it hasantioxidants and anti-inflammatorymagic properties.

saccharomyces-ferment.name: Saccharomyces Ferment
