hydroxypropyl-bispalmitamide-mea.name: Hydroxypropyl Bispalmitamide MEA
hydroxypropyl-bispalmitamide-mea.description_en: Abio-mimeticceramide moleculethatis claimed to be similarly effective asceramide 3at moisturizing the skin and helping the barrier function. We havemore about ceramides here.

ceresin.name: Ceresin
ceresin.description_en: A hydrocarbon wax produced by the purification of anotherhydrocarbon wax,ozokerite. Similar to ozokerite, it is mostly used instick type products to keep them nice and solid.

citrus-unshiu-peel-extract.name: Citrus Unshiu Peel Extract
citrus-unshiu-peel-extract.description_en: Out of the more than 900 Citrus species known today, Citrus Unshiu is a seedless, easy to peel tangerine coming from the Japanese town Satsuma. The peel extract used in cosmetics is mainly created from the "press-cake", the by-product of the juice industry and as it turns out, what's waste to one industry is a useful ingredient to another.

sodium-methyl-oleoyl-taurate.name: Sodium Methyl Oleoyl Taurate
sodium-methyl-oleoyl-taurate.description_en: A sulfate-free,mild cleansing agentthat is used next to other cleansing agents (aka co-surfactant) mainly as afoam booster and viscosity builder.

melaleuca-alternifolia-leaf-water.name: Melaleuca Alternifolia Leaf Water
melaleuca-alternifolia-leaf-water.description_en: The much-much diluted version of the famousTea Tree Essential Oil, the so-calledhydrosolthat is created as aby-product of steam-distillationused for producing essential oils. In general, hydrosols contain the same components as their big sister essential oil but in way-reduced concentrations. We have seen a specification saying 99% of the tea tree water is water, and about 1% consists of very small amounts of the dissolved essential oil and the water-soluble parts of the tea tree leaves.

lauryl-methacrylate-sodium-methacrylate-.name: Lauryl Methacrylate/​Sodium Methacrylate Crosspolymer
lauryl-methacrylate-sodium-methacrylate-.description_en: A synthetic copolymer (big molecule from repeated subunits) that is used as aslip and surface modifier. It is claimed to give sunscreen formulas long-lasting, lightweight and non-sticky properties.

cetyl-lactate.name: Cetyl Lactate
cetyl-lactate.description_en: Cetyl Lactate is amultipurpose emollientthat gives the formula a nice slip and makes your skin silky and smooth. It is also claimed to reduce tackiness and greasiness in the formulation.

acacia-decurrens-jojoba-sunflower-seed-w.name: Acacia Decurrens/​Jojoba/​ Sunflower Seed Wax Polyglyceryl-3 Esters
acacia-decurrens-jojoba-sunflower-seed-w.description_en: A 100% plant-basedmoisturizing and texturizing agentthat is based on the transesterification of Sunflower, Jojoba, and Mimosa waxes. The resulting material is asoft, smooth butterhalfway between liquid emollients and solid butters.
acacia-decurrens-jojoba-sunflower-seed-w.inci_name: ACACIA DECURRENS JOJOBA SUNFLOWER SEED WAX POLYGLYCERYL 3 ESTERS

terephthalylidene-dicamphor-sulfonic-aci.name: Terephthalylidene Dicamphor Sulfonic Acid
terephthalylidene-dicamphor-sulfonic-aci.description_en: AL'Oréal-group exclusive sunscreen agentcommonly called Mexoryl SX. As opposed to most sunscreen agents, it is water soluble andprotects in the UVA rangewith a peak absorbance at 345 nm.

polyamide-8.name: Polyamide-8
polyamide-8.description_en: A so-called organogellant (a gelling agent that likes organic compounds such as oils) that helps toincrease the viscosity of the oils phasein the formula.

retinyl-retinoate.name: Retinyl Retinoate
retinyl-retinoate.description_en: Retinyl Retinoate (RR) is a less well known but super interestingmember of theretinoids(vitamin A derivatives), aka the "royal family of skincare".  Unless you live under a skincare-news-shielding rock, you must have heard abouttretinoin, the FDA-approved anti-aging superstar, andretinol, the most common OTC version of tretinoin. You can read more aboutwhos-who in the retinoid family here.

aristotelia-chilensis-oil.name: Aristotelia Chilensis Oil
aristotelia-chilensis-oil.description_en: Maqui Berries aresmall, dark berries, similar to better-known blackberries, thatgrow natively inthe temperate rainforests ofChile. The fruit is touted as a "superfruit" rich in antioxidant anthocyanins and other phenolics.

hydrogen-dimethicone.name: Hydrogen Dimethicone
hydrogen-dimethicone.description_en: A silicone molecule that is half-way betweenDimethiconeandMethicone, meaning that some of the methyl (-CH3) groups are replaced with a hydrogen atom (in Methicone half of the CH3 groups are replaced). This makes Hydrogen Dimethicone a handypigment bonding agent used for the hydrophobization treatment of powdersas the H atoms can absorb traces of water from the surface of pigments.

sodium-acetylated-hyaluronate.name: Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate
sodium-acetylated-hyaluronate.description_en: Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate is a variation of current IT moisturizer,Hyaluronic acid, where some water-loving -OH groups are replaced by amphipathic (partly water-loving and partly water-hating) acetyl groups. The modified molecule isclaimedto have evenbetter moisture retention ability than normal HAand better affinity to the skin surface.

acetyl-tetrapeptide-3.name: Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3
acetyl-tetrapeptide-3.description_en: A relatively new,four amino acid peptidethat promises tohelp combat hair lossalongsidered clover extractas part of the trademarked technologyCapixyl.

polyglyceryl-10-eicosanedioate-tetradeca.name: Polyglyceryl-10 Eicosanedioate/​Tetradecanedioate
polyglyceryl-10-eicosanedioate-tetradeca.description_en: Anoily liquid(ester) that is not oil-soluble (as most other esters), butwater soluble. It has niceemollientand skin moisturizing properties, and an elegant skin-feel. It can also reduce the stickiness of glycerin and oils in the formula.

polypropylsilsesquioxane.name: Polypropylsilsesquioxane
polypropylsilsesquioxane.description_en: Polypropylsilsesquioxane is asilicone resinthat forms aflexible, durable film on the skin.The film is resistant to wash-off and rub-off and is useful for creating long-lasting makeup products and sunscreens.

hydroxymethoxyphenyl-decanone.name: Hydroxymethoxyphenyl Decanone
hydroxymethoxyphenyl-decanone.description_en: A nature-identical (but synthetic) molecule that copies a phyto-active found ingrains of paradise, a spice from the ginger family. It isclaimedto be a4-in-1 active with potent topical & cellular antioxidant, anti-irritant, and hyaluronic acid boosteractivity, however, the manufacturer did only some in-vitro and ex-vivo (as in nothing done on real people... ) tests to back up these claims.

acrylates-dimethicone-copolymer.name: Acrylates/​Dimethicone Copolymer
acrylates-dimethicone-copolymer.description_en: A polymer molecule (big molecule from repeated subunits) whose main thing is being afilm-former.

mannose.name: Mannose
mannose.description_en: Mannose is one of the manysugar molecules out there and similar to the other ones, it works as a greathumectantand moisturizer in cosmetic products.

c30-45-alkyl-dimethicone.name: C30-45 Alkyl Dimethicone
c30-45-alkyl-dimethicone.description_en: Asilicone waxthat functions as a thickening agent and also gives great lubricity and skin feel.

sodium-lauryl-sulfate.name: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate
sodium-lauryl-sulfate.description_en: The famous or rather infamous SLS (not to be confused withSLES). It is acleansing agentknown for being too good at the job and potentiallyirritatingthe skin. But, on the positive side,  it can producecopious, creamy and luxurious foamcompared to the more gentle and thus nowadays much more commonly usedSodium Laureth Sulfate.

pseudozyma-epicola.name: Pseudozyma Epicola
pseudozyma-epicola.description_en: Abacteria species that can ferment plant oilsby producing enzymes and is used to create "fermented oils". The fermentation process produces various types of polysaccharides and lipids and increases the free fatty acid content of the oils. Fermented oils also tend to have quicker skin absorption, a less-greasy skin feeling and are easier to mix with water, aka emulsify.

retinyl-propionate.name: Retinyl Propionate
retinyl-propionate.description_en: Retinyl Propionate (RP) is a less well-known, but pretty interestingmember ofthe retinoids, aka the "royal family of skincare". You can read thewho's who herebut the TL;DR version is thattretinoinis the king himself (the FDA-proven anti-aging active molecule),retinolis like Prince George (two conversion steps needed to be active) andRetinyl Palmitateis like PrinceCharlotte (George's little sister), 3 steps away from the throne.

copper-palmitoyl-heptapeptide-14.name: Copper Palmitoyl Heptapeptide-14
copper-palmitoyl-heptapeptide-14.description_en: Copper Palmitoyl Heptapeptide-14 is the payload peptide (a short chain of amino acids) in theencapsulated copper peptidetechnology trade named X50 Antiaging. The delivery system (called The Cosmetic Drone) is a high-tech capsule where our peptide is wrapped in a biocompatible polymer shell (created from Lactic Acid/Glycolic Acid Copolymer, Polyvinyl Alcohol) andanother peptide, which has an affinity to the fibroblast receptors, sits on the outside of the capsule and guides it to the right place in the skin.

benzophenone-5.name: Benzophenone-5
benzophenone-5.description_en: Benzophenone-5 is the sodium salt brother ofBenzophenone-4, and just like that guy, this one also works mainly as aphotoprotectant to extend product shelf life, or as acolor-protectantfor products in clear packages.

sodium-phenylbenzimidazole-sulfonate.name: Sodium Phenylbenzimidazole Sulfonate
sodium-phenylbenzimidazole-sulfonate.description_en: The salt form of thewater-soluble chemical sunscreen,Ensulizole. What we wrote there (UVB filterwith a peak protection at 306 nm), applies here as well.

coptis-japonica-root-extract.name: Coptis Japonica Root Extract
coptis-japonica-root-extract.description_en: The extract coming from the root of thetraditional medicinal herb, Coptis Japonica or Japanese Goldthread. The plant is used traditionally in East Asia for itsanti-inflammatory, antioxidant and antimicrobialabilities.

rosmarinyl-glucoside.name: Rosmarinyl Glucoside
rosmarinyl-glucoside.description_en: The water-soluble, stabilized andbio-available version of rosmarinic acid(rosmarinic acid attached to the sugar molecule, glucose), the active super component inRosemary. It is known for itspotent antioxidant and anti-inflammatoryproperties.

caffeyl-glucoside.name: Caffeyl Glucoside
caffeyl-glucoside.description_en: The water-soluble,stabilized, and purified version of the famous antioxidant molecule, caffeic acid(caffeic acid attached to the sugar molecule, glucose), the main phyto-active of green coffee. Caffeyl Glucoside is alsoclaimedto have astrong anti-inflammatory and photoprotective effect.

polysilicone-15.name: Polysilicone-15
polysilicone-15.description_en: A silicone-based,chemical sunscreen agentthat protects the skin in theUVBrange (290-320 nm) with a peak absorbance at 312 nm. It is a colorless to pale yellow liquid with nice and non-shiny (at least compared to most other sunscreens) sensorial properties.

asiatic-acid.name: Asiatic Acid
asiatic-acid.description_en: One of the biologically active components ofGotu Kola. It's a bit less prominent than its sister component,Asiaticoside, but in-vitro (made in the lab) studies show that Asiatic Acid also stimulates GAGs (glycosaminoglycans - polysaccharides that are part of the liquidy stuff between our skin cells) production as well as collagen I synthesis.

tremella-fuciformis-polysaccharide.name: Tremella Fuciformis Polysaccharide
tremella-fuciformis-polysaccharide.description_en: A  big sugar molecule coming from the edible fruit bodies of theSilver Ear mushroom in China. Its sugar constituents includeGlucuronic acid, the same guy that is one of the building blocks of IT-moisturizerHyaluronic Acid. It is claimed to have similarly awesome water-binding capacities meaning it works as anexcellent skin moisturizer and humectant.

sodium-methyl-stearoyl-taurate.name: Sodium Methyl Stearoyl Taurate
sodium-methyl-stearoyl-taurate.description_en: Amild cleansing agentthat's used mainly next to other cleansing agents (co-surfactant)  toimprove foam density and regulate viscosity.

glycereth-7-trimethyl-ether.name: Glycereth-7 Trimethyl Ether
glycereth-7-trimethyl-ether.description_en: A light yellow liquid ester that gives aslightly dry, silky emollienceon the skin. Its unique property is that it is both water-soluble as well as castor oil soluble. This dual solubility is a rare trait that enables the addition of water into waterless formulas, such as lipsticks or balms.

secale-cereale-seed-extract.name: Secale Cereale Seed Extract
secale-cereale-seed-extract.description_en: As a plant extract, it is hard to know what it is exactly: it might be little exfoliant particles, or - if you are looking at the ingredient list of an anti-aging product - it is most likely a rye extract rich in arabinoxylans with possibleskin smoothing and glow enhancing properties.

poloxamer-188.name: Poloxamer 188
poloxamer-188.description_en: A synthetic big copolymer molecule that is used as asolubilizer, mild cleansing agent and foam boosteror stabilizer.

polyquaternium-37.name: Polyquaternium-37
polyquaternium-37.description_en: A cationic polymer molecule (a big molecule with repeated subunits and a positive charge) that acts both as a film-former andconditioning ingredient as well as a thickening agent.

diethylhexyl-2-6-naphthalate.name: Diethylhexyl 2,6-Naphthalate
diethylhexyl-2-6-naphthalate.description_en: Anoily, emollient liquidthat works as aphotostabilizer and solvent in sunscreen formulas. More specifically, it helps to stabilize famous UVA filter,Avobenzoneand it is also an excellent solvent for oil-soluble, solid sunscreen agents.

myristyl-nicotinate.name: Myristyl Nicotinate
myristyl-nicotinate.description_en: Myristyl Nicotinate (MN) might not sound familiar, butNiacinamideprobably does. If it does not,click here to catch up. Our molecule is anoil-soluble derivative of skincare superstar, niacinamidethat was developed to deliver nicotinic acid to the skin without causing flushing (tiny amounts of the acid form of niacinamide cause skin flushing, but otherwise, it is a skin goodie similar to nia).

gelatin.name: Gelatin
gelatin.description_en: Ananimal-derived gelling agentthat is a close relative toHydrolyzed Collagen. It is created from the connective tissue (bone and skin) of animals (usually cows or pigs) and helps to thicken up water-based formulas.

methyl-diisopropyl-propionamide.name: Methyl Diisopropyl Propionamide
methyl-diisopropyl-propionamide.description_en: A molecule that gives along-lasting cooling and chilling effectto the formula. It is not derived frommentholand,  according to the manufacturer, is not allergenic.

myristyl-malate-phosphonic-acid.name: Myristyl Malate Phosphonic Acid
myristyl-malate-phosphonic-acid.description_en: Myristyl Malate Phosphonic Acid (let’s call it MMPA) is asynthetic phospholipid. You may have heard ofphospholipidsin your biology class, since they’re a main component in human cell membranes. Because of this, it makes sense that cosmetic companies want to try making some similar molecules for skin care - our skin is made of cells, after all!

ppg-10-methyl-glucose-ether.name: PPG-10 Methyl Glucose Ether
ppg-10-methyl-glucose-ether.description_en: A sugar derived liquid that works as awater-soluble emollient(makes your skin nice and smooth), fragrance fixative andhumectant(helps skin to hold onto water) on the skin.

disodium-phenyl-dibenzimidazole-tetrasul.name: Disodium Phenyl Dibenzimidazole Tetrasulfonate
disodium-phenyl-dibenzimidazole-tetrasul.description_en: This long-named molecule is achemical sunscreen agentthat protects the skin from theUVA II rays(320-350 nm mainly) with a peak absorbance at 335 nm. Unlike most other sunscreen filters, it is not oil, but water-soluble helping formulators to create less greasy sunscreens.

benzotriazolyl-dodecyl-p-cresol.name: Benzotriazolyl Dodecyl P-Cresol
benzotriazolyl-dodecyl-p-cresol.description_en: Benzotriazolyl Dodecyl P-Cresol is a broadband UV absorber used to stabilize products in transparent packaging. It protects sensitive ingredients such as colors, fragrances, or natural extracts fromphotooxidative degradation. The recommended usage rate is0.01% - 0.1%.

mentha-piperita-leaf-oil.name: Mentha Piperita Leaf Oil
mentha-piperita-leaf-oil.description_en: Some variation ofpeppermint essential oilknown for its grassy-minty smell and refreshing sensations. Its main active component ismenthol, a known skin irritant.Read more here >>

diisostearoyl-polyglyceryl-3-dimer-dilin.name: Diisostearoyl Polyglyceryl-3 Dimer Dilinoleate
diisostearoyl-polyglyceryl-3-dimer-dilin.description_en: A viscous oily liquid (ester) that is known forproviding extraordinarily long-lasting coverage. It is used to enhance water resistance in sunscreen formulas or to give long-wear properties to makeup items such as lipsticks or smudge-proof mascaras.

sodium-acrylates-c10-30-alkyl-acrylate-c.name: Sodium Acrylates/​C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer
sodium-acrylates-c10-30-alkyl-acrylate-c.description_en: A pre-neutralised form of super commonthickener and emulsion stabilizer,Acrylates/ C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer. We have more info atCarbomerandAcrylates/​C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer.
sodium-acrylates-c10-30-alkyl-acrylate-c.inci_name: SODIUM ACRYLATES C10 30 ALKYL ACRYLATE CROSSPOLYMER

myristoyl-hexapeptide-16.name: Myristoyl Hexapeptide-16
myristoyl-hexapeptide-16.description_en: A six amino acid peptide (Leu-Lys-Lys-Thr-Glu-Thr) attached to the oil-soluble fatty acid, myristic acid for better bioavailability. It is known tosignificantly stimulate keratin genes, i. e. it can convince the cells to produce more keratin, the super important structural protein in hair, nails and the outermost layer of the skin.

myristoyl-pentapeptide-17.name: Myristoyl Pentapeptide-17
myristoyl-pentapeptide-17.description_en: A five amino acid peptide (Lys-Leu-Ala-Lys-Lys) attached to the oil-soluble fatty acid, myristic acid for better bioavailability. It is known to significantlystimulate keratin genes, i. e. it can convince the cells to produce more keratin, the super important structural protein in hair, nails and the outermost layer of the skin.

human-adipose-derived-stem-cell-conditio.name: Human Adipose Derived Stem Cell Conditioned Media
human-adipose-derived-stem-cell-conditio.description_en: If you see "some kind of cell conditioned media" on the ingredient list, it always means aGrowth Factor Cocktail for your skin. In this case, we are talking about Adipose-Derived Stem Cells (ADSC), i.e. cells that differentiate later into fat cells.  These cells are known to secrete various growth factors that have significantwound healing and antioxidant properties.
human-adipose-derived-stem-cell-conditio.inci_name: HUMAN ADIPOSE DERIVED STEM CELL CONDITIONED MEDIA

propane.name: Propane
propane.description_en: The small sister ofButane(once carbon shorter chain length alkane), Propane is also a gas used as apropellantin cosmetic products.

rutin.name: Rutin
rutin.description_en: Rutin is apolyphenol flavonoidfound in many plants, for example, citrus fruits. The main reason it's used in cosmetics is its highantioxidantand free radical-scavenging ability (similar to that of superstarascorbic acid), but also has some antibacterial nature and wound-healing properties.

cetylhydroxyproline-palmitamide.name: Cetylhydroxyproline Palmitamide
cetylhydroxyproline-palmitamide.description_en: A pseudo-ceramide that is similar to Ceramide 2 in structure and activity and is claimed to be a great ingredient for ahealthy skin barrier or to repair damaged skinor hair. In general, Ceramides are super important lipids in the outer layer of the skin andwe have written some more about them here >>

opuntia-ficus-indica-fruit-extract.name: Opuntia Ficus-Indica Fruit Extract
opuntia-ficus-indica-fruit-extract.description_en: The extract of Prickly Pear, a cactus that’s native to Mexico. Its main unique thing is that it canreduce the neurosensory irritationcaused by the application of topical products such as retinoids (slow reaction) or alpha hydroxy acids (fast reaction). We have a shiny description aboutOpuntia Ficus-Indica Extract here >>

c15-19-alkane.name: C15-19 Alkane
c15-19-alkane.description_en: A nice-feeling, light emollient that makes the skin soft and smooth. It gives a fresh and gliding sensation with a powdery or soft after-feel depending on the exact grade used. It is a popular alternative to replace silicones.

hydrolyzed-placental-protein.name: Hydrolyzed Placental Protein
hydrolyzed-placental-protein.description_en: A chemically chopped up version of protein coming from bovine placenta (yes, it is an animal-derived ingredient). Proteins are long amino acid chains, so when you chop them up you get peptides (short amino-acid chains) and amino acids, nice molecules that are known as the "building blocks of life".

dilinoleic-acid-propanediol-copolymer.name: Dilinoleic Acid/​Propanediol Copolymer
dilinoleic-acid-propanediol-copolymer.description_en: Dilinoleic Acid/Propanediol Copolymer is aslightly tacky, glossy emollient that is commonly used in lip productsas it is soluble in lip product's favorite oil,castor oil; it sticks well to the skin (substantive) and gives a nice glossy appearance.

ci-77510.name: Ci 77510
ci-77510.description_en: An inorganic (as in no carbon in its molecule)pigmentthat has avery intense, dark blue color. It is not permitted in lip products in the US, and only the version Ferric Ammonium Ferrocyanide is permitted in the EU.

eucalyptus-citriodora-oil.name: Eucalyptus Citriodora Oil
eucalyptus-citriodora-oil.description_en: The essential oil coming from Eucalyptus Citriodora that has a surprisingly different chemical structure from the better known, and much more commonly usedEucalyptus Globulus essential oil. It contains hardly any eucalyptol (0.6%), but its main components arecitronellal(85%) andlimonene(15%) giving the oil a strong,fresh, sweet, and balsamic aroma.

biotinoyl-tripeptide-1.name: Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1
biotinoyl-tripeptide-1.description_en: A three amino acid peptide where thefamous collagen fragment, Tripeptide-1, aka GHK is combined withBiotin, the well-known supplement for stronger nails and hairs. The result of the combination is Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1, a peptideclaimedto behelpful for reducing hair lossand formaking the eyelashes appear longer, fuller, and stronger.

ethyl-menthane-carboxamide.name: Ethyl Menthane Carboxamide
ethyl-menthane-carboxamide.description_en: A menthol derivative that gives astrong cooling effect on the skin(and in the mouth). But, unlikementhol, it is virtually nonvolatile, odorless and tasteless.

potassium-acrylates-c10-30-alkyl-acrylat.name: Potassium Acrylates/​C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer
potassium-acrylates-c10-30-alkyl-acrylat.description_en: A pre-neutralised form of super commonthickener and emulsion stabilizer,Acrylates/ C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer. We have more info atCarbomerandAcrylates/​C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer.
potassium-acrylates-c10-30-alkyl-acrylat.inci_name: POTASSIUM ACRYLATES C10 30 ALKYL ACRYLATE CROSSPOLYMER

phytosteryl-macadamiate.name: Phytosteryl Macadamiate
phytosteryl-macadamiate.description_en: Phytosteryl Macadamiate is the combination of phytosterol and fatty acids coming from Macadamia oil. It is a botanical version of cholesteryl esters found in skin surface lipids. It comes to the ingredient list as part of L22, a skin surface lipid mimetic whose main job isbarrier repair and skin hydration.

jojoba-oil-macadamia-seed-oil-esters.name: Jojoba Oil/​Macadamia Seed Oil Esters
jojoba-oil-macadamia-seed-oil-esters.description_en: Jojoba Oil/Macadamia Seed Oil Esters is the major component of a skin surface lipid mimetic mixture trade named L22.
jojoba-oil-macadamia-seed-oil-esters.inci_name: JOJOBA OIL MACADAMIA SEED OIL ESTERS

aphanizomenon-flos-aquae-extract.name: Aphanizomenon Flos-Aquae Extract
aphanizomenon-flos-aquae-extract.description_en: The extract coming from arare, blue-green algaethat'stoutedto haveretinoid-like effectsbut without the side effect. If you do not know what retinoids are, you are seriously missing out,please click here and catch up on the topic.

ci-77289.name: Ci 77289
ci-77289.description_en: An inorganic (as in no carbon in its molecule, it is Cr2O3X(OH), the hydrated version ofthis guy) pigment that givesblue-green shades. It is not permitted in lip products in the US.

diisopropyl-dimer-dilinoleate.name: Diisopropyl Dimer Dilinoleate
diisopropyl-dimer-dilinoleate.description_en: Diisopropyl Dimer Dilinoleate is an oil-like, emollient liquid that gives a cushiony feel to skinand make-up products. It has a good combination of rich feel, but good slip and low tack. It is also popular in lipsticks and lip glosses instead of lanolin or castor oil.

sodium-stearate.name: Sodium Stearate
sodium-stearate.description_en: A very classic, old-school cleansing agent, asoap(the sodium salt ofStearic Acid). It is known for itsrich, creamy foamand being quiteharsh on the skin.

isopropyl-cloprostenate.name: Isopropyl Cloprostenate
isopropyl-cloprostenate.description_en: Asynthetic prostaglandin analogthat belongs to the same class of actives used originally on glaucoma patients. As a side effect,people noticed longer and stronger eyelashesso prostaglandin analogs made their way into eyelash growth products.

hydrolyzed-marine-collagen.name: Hydrolyzed Marine Collagen
hydrolyzed-marine-collagen.description_en: The chemically chopped up version of collagen coming from a marine (fish) source. It works as amoisturizer and emollient. Read more abouthydrolyzed collagenhere >>

palmitoyl-hexapeptide-19.name: Palmitoyl Hexapeptide-19
palmitoyl-hexapeptide-19.description_en: ABotox-mimicking peptide(kind of like the famousArgireline) that is supposed torelax the mimic facial wrinklessuch as crow's feet or thinker's wrinkles. It is obviously not as effective as real Botox, butaccording to the manufacturer's data, 5% of the BoNT-L peptide liquid (the diluted, sold version of the peptide) can reduce mimic wrinkles by 38% in 28 days (tested on 15 volunteers).

citrus-unshiu-extract.name: Citrus Unshiu Extract
citrus-unshiu-extract.description_en: The extract coming from the Satsuma Mandarin, an easy to peel, seedless citrus from Japan. Mainly the peel extract is used in cosmetics for itsskin-brightening and antioxidantabilities. We have some more details atCitrus Unshiu Peel Extract >>

n-butyl-alcohol.name: N-Butyl Alcohol
n-butyl-alcohol.description_en: A clear, colorless liquid with a wine-like odor. It is usually used in tiny amounts as anaromatic and flavor ingredient.

cocamidopropylamine-oxide.name: Cocamidopropylamine Oxide
cocamidopropylamine-oxide.description_en: Asecondary cleansing agent(co-surfactant) that's a good aid next to other (anionic) cleansing agents. It improves foam, the mildness of the formula and builds viscosity, pretty much all the things co-surfactants are used for.

anthocyanins.name: Anthocyanins
anthocyanins.description_en: A water-soluble,natural colorant(a dye) that givesred&purple shades. Anthocyanins are also the dyes that give several edible fruits and berries their color such as acai, blackcurrant or raspberry.

dmpa-isophthalic-acid-smdi-copolymer.name: Dmpa/​Isophthalic Acid/​Smdi Copolymer
dmpa-isophthalic-acid-smdi-copolymer.description_en: A clear polymer (big molecule from repeated subunits) molecule that is used to coatsilica beadsto modify its light reflecting properties andcreate the illusion of a smoother skin surfaceand obscures imperfections.

disiloxane.name: Disiloxane
disiloxane.description_en: Avery thin and very volatile(evaporates from the skin rather than absorbs into it)silicone fluidthat gives silky softness and great spreadability to the formulas.

ethylhexyl-dimethyl-paba.name: Ethylhexyl Dimethyl PABA
ethylhexyl-dimethyl-paba.description_en: Ethylhexyl Dimethyl PABA is achemical sunscreen agentthat protects in theUVBrange (290-320 nm) with a peak absorbance at 312nm. Other than that, we struggle to write anything positive about this guy, as it is photo unstable (looses 10% efficacy in 20 mins and 50% in 85 mins), not an unfrequent allergen in sunscreens and shows some endocrine effect in animal studies.

castor-oil-ipdi-copolymer.name: Castor Oil/​IPDI Copolymer
castor-oil-ipdi-copolymer.description_en: A castor oil-derived polymer that canthicken up oils. It can form clear oily gels, and it can also suspend particles such as pigments, glitters, or mineral filters.

ci-77947.name: CI 77947
ci-77947.description_en: CI 77947 is the name of Zinc Oxide on the ingredient label when it is used as a colorant.

polyglyceryl-3-cetearyl-ether-olivate.name: Polyglyceryl-3 Cetearyl Ether Olivate
polyglyceryl-3-cetearyl-ether-olivate.description_en: An olive oil-derived emulsifier (helps to mix water and oil) that creates light emulsions with a velvety skin feel. The recommended usage concentration is 4-6%.

phytosteryl-sunflowerseedate.name: Phytosteryl Sunflowerseedate
phytosteryl-sunflowerseedate.description_en: There is not much information about Phytosteryl Sunflowerseedate on its own out there, but it usually comes to the formula combined withDilinoleic Acid/​Propanediol CopolymerandHydrogenated Vegetable Glycerides. The trio acts as avegetable lanolin alternative, bringing rich emollience to the formula.

maleated-soybean-oil-glyceryl-octyldodec.name: Maleated Soybean Oil Glyceryl/​Octyldodecanol Esters
maleated-soybean-oil-glyceryl-octyldodec.description_en: An environmentally friendly,biodegradable film former and SPF boosterused in sunscreen products. It helps sunscreens create a nice, even layer on the skin that stays there for a long time.
maleated-soybean-oil-glyceryl-octyldodec.inci_name: MALEATED SOYBEAN OIL GLYCERYL OCTYLDODECANOL ESTERS

methoxyphenylimino-dimethylcyclohexenyl-.name: Methoxyphenylimino Dimethylcyclohexenyl Ethyl Glycinate
methoxyphenylimino-dimethylcyclohexenyl-.description_en: Methoxyphenylimino Dimethylcyclohexenyl Ethyl Glycinate is a biomimetic ingredient that copies secondary metabolites produced by marine organisms to protect themselves from UV radiation. Thus, the ingredient is also claimed to work as anSPF boosterand to provide color and fragrance protection in formulas.

witch-hazel.name: Hamamelis Virginiana Extract
witch-hazel.description_en: Witch hazel is a smallish tree (up to 5m) that's native to North-America, has nice yellow flowers and is similar to the hazelnut bush (hence the name).

rosemary.name: Rosmarinus Officinalis Leaf Extract
rosemary.description_en: The extract coming from the lovely herb, rosemary. It contains lots of chemicals, includingflavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes. Its main active isrosmarinic acid, apotent antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory. It has alsoanti-bacterial, astringent and toningproperties.

oleate-de-polyglyceryle-10-extrait-de-fe.inci_name: OLÉATE DE POLYGLYCÉRYLE-10, EXTRAIT DE FEUILLE DE VISCUM ALBUM

jojoba.name: Simmondsia Chinensis Seed Oil
jojoba.description_en: Jojoba is a drought resistant evergreen shrub native to South-western North America. It's known and grown for jojoba oil, the golden yellow liquid coming from the seeds (about 50% of the weight of the seeds will be oil).

isosteate-de-polyglyceryle-10-extrait-de.inci_name: ISOSTÉATE DE POLYGLYCÉRYLE-10, EXTRAIT DE LAVANDULA ANGUSTIFOLIA

extrait-de-fruit-de-gardenia-florida.inci_name: EXTRAIT DE FRUIT DE GARDENIA FLORIDA

extrait-de-fruit-de-carica-papaya.inci_name: EXTRAIT DE FRUIT DE CARICA PAPAYA

extrait-de-fleur-de-chamomilla-recutita.inci_name: EXTRAIT DE FLEUR DE CHAMOMILLA RECUTITA

extrait-de-feuille-de-chamaecyparis-obtu.inci_name: EXTRAIT DE FEUILLE DE CHAMAECYPARIS OBTUSA

extrait-de-ecorce-de-cinnamomum-cassia.inci_name: EXTRAIT DE ÉCORCE DE CINNAMOMUM CASSIA

extrait-de-cortex-de-salix-alba.inci_name: EXTRAIT DE CORTEX DE SALIX ALBA

dipotassium-glycyrrhizinate.name: Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate
dipotassium-glycyrrhizinate.description_en: The salt form of one of the main anti-inflammatory ingredients in the licorice plant, monoammonium glycyrrhizinate. It’s a yellowish powder with a nice sweet smell.

sunflower.name: Sunflower
sunflower.inci_name: HELIANTHUS ANNUUS (SUNFLOWER) SEED OIL (HELIANTHUS ANNUUS SEED OIL)

sweet-almond.name: Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis Oil
sweet-almond.description_en: Theemollient plant oilthat comesfrom almonds. Similar to other plant oils, it is loaded with skin-nourishing fatty acids (oleic acid- 55-86% andlinoleic acid7-35%) and contains several other skin goodies such as antioxidantvitamin E and vitamin Bversions.

huile-de-graine-de-macadamia-ternifolia.inci_name: HUILE DE GRAINE DE MACADAMIA TERNIFOLIA
